title: Card meta limit counts lines, projection list facets honour narrowPlacement
detail: The boot rule `list/card-meta-overflow` counted every meta column, so a run of `narrowInline` columns that the card draws on one line failed the boot. It now counts lines. `ListFacetSpec` takes `narrowPlacement`, so a facet of a projection list can open behind the filter icon on a phone, as on entity lists.

title: Bottom drawers stay docked on narrow viewports
detail: Below the narrow breakpoint every Drawer went full-screen and ignored `side`. With `side="bottom"` the panel now stays at the bottom edge with the dimmed page behind it. Other sides keep the full-screen layout.

title: detail pages show one h1 at a time, stat warn tone uses status-warn
detail: DefaultPageHeader sets the bodyTitle flag in a layout effect, so the shell breadcrumb no longer paints its own h1 next to the page's h1 under a slow CPU. The `warn` tone of StatCard, StatStripCell and MiniStat used the destructive color; it now uses `status-warn` and `status-warn-surface` like the other widgets.

title: board gaps round 11, drawn icons, facet labels, empty list header, short forms, bell in the menu
detail: Visible change for all apps: the search, sparkles, wand and pencil icons (`Icon` keys `search`, `sparkles`, `wand`, `pencil`), the list search field, the nav search and the filter toggle use new drawn icons, exported from renderer/web as `DrawnSearch`, `DrawnSparkles`, `DrawnPencil`, `DrawnFilter`, `DrawnWand`, `DrawnPanel`. `navStyle` plain shows `DrawnPanel` on every width instead of the hamburger. Facet triggers split "Label: " grey from the value in its own span (`facet-<field>-value`), the sort select too (`<testId>-value`); with `narrowFacets` pills an empty select shows the label only. New options - `NamedFilterFacetOptions.hideEmpty` (zero-hit entries leave the select, "all" and the active entry stay; the counts are requested without `showCounts`), `ListColumnHint.narrowField` (shorter sentence on the phone card), `RecordStep.narrowTitle`, `RecordNotice.narrowTitle` and `narrowText` (also `BannerProps`), `WorkspaceShell.notificationBellPlacement: "header" | "overflow"` (overflow moves the bell into the always-visible "…" menu). `narrowPlacement: "behind-filter"` now works on lists that do not fill their height (search and filter toggle share one row below sm). A `frame: "card"` list from sm up keeps its header row when empty, with the empty state in the same card. Boot rule `query/output-field-missing` also checks `hint.narrowField`; the projectionList count-acceptance rule also applies to `hideEmpty`.

title: WorkspaceShell contentSurface and navStyle, board look for lists, panels and detail pages
detail: `WorkspaceShell` takes `contentSurface?: "card" | "background"` (default "card") and `navStyle?: "default" | "plain"` (default "default"). `plain` drops the leading icons of the expanded sidebar, styles groups, entries, active entry and search like the board, shows the create plus of an entry only on hover and focus (always on coarse pointers), renders a visible plus on a group's label, shows the hamburger in the header (also in the Akte header on desktop) and sets the header to 58px. Defaults changed for all apps: the notification bell has no border, its counter is a small destructive pill; the dashboard panel header has no divider and board spacing, the titled stat strip is a grid, panel stat tiles use the page background; the pager footer reads "1–10 von 26 · 10 pro Seite" (no noun, no arrow at the page size, plain page buttons); the summary and totals row of a table keep their background under the sticky actions column; select-facet triggers show the label grey and the value in foreground or primary when set; select-facet dropdown counters sit right and a chip can set `separatorAfter` (new on `EntityListFacetExtraOption`); tab counts are pills; metric tiles show `sub` on its own line; Fristen date cells are mono; button columns of a dashboard list are right-aligned. `kumiko.pager.status.noun` is removed (unused). Also new: `NamedListFilterRef.emptyState` takes `paramsQuery` (a registered query QN without payload, run only while the empty state is on screen; its result object becomes the translation params of `description`; without data the description is not rendered; boot rules `list/named-filter-empty-state-params-query-empty`, `...-without-description` and `query/not-registered`); `NamedListFilterRef.separatorAfter`; `narrowPlacement: "behind-filter"` on `EntityListFacetConfig` and `NamedFilterFacetOptions` (the remaining facets follow the usual phone rules, both clusters share one filter toggle); `prefix` on a detail header subtitle part; `MetricSpec.subFieldNarrow`; `steps.narrowMoreLabel`, a plural base key (`<key>.one` and `<key>.other` with `{count}`; default `kumiko.detail.steps.more`). Phone cards and dashboard cards draw the tone as an inner 4px stripe instead of a left border; table row tone stripes are 4px; further step actions are grey 12.5px; the phone stat strip has no tone border; the chain panel beside the steps stretches to their height. Phone detail pages and lists: new list column option `narrowInline` (consecutive columns with it share one line of values with a 12px gap on a phone card, no separator; other apps are unaffected until they set it); new `CardOptions.headerLayout: "stacked" | "inline"` (inline puts title, subtitle and actions on one row without a divider; the chain panel uses it); `StatCard` takes `boardPadding`; the pager of a phone card list is plain text on the page without bar or border and the sort sentence is a muted 12px line; the lead paragraph of a dashboard text panel is followed by a smaller dated hint line; the page heading is 20px on a phone, detail pages use 16px side insets there, steps are divided rows with a 4px tone stripe and a "more steps" toggle row, the record summary has a heading-face sentence with a left stripe, metric tiles use 2-column phone spacing with a short `narrowSub` beside the value, and tab strips scroll sideways with tighter spacing on a phone. `StepList` for a plan card: `StepListSelection.compact` (no select-all row, selection actions visible at 0 selected, muted header, left-aligned footer, the checkbox replaces the status icon of selectable rows), `StepSelectionAction.labelForCount(count)` (replaces the appended " (n)", the action is disabled at 0), `StepSelectionAction.ignoresSelection` (no counter, always enabled, `onClick` still gets the selection), `StepTag.side` (tag in the right column above a trailing link), `progress: "total"` ("n steps", keys `kumiko.widget.step-list.total.one` and `.other`) and `footerNote`. In a list or dashboard panel with row tones every narrow card now carries the stripe, grey for neutral rows, so all cards share one inset. A filter toggle on the phone is marked active while a facet behind it is set.

title: Dropping the pwa option retires the leftover service worker
detail: Without the shell meta, the web client unregisters the service worker for its own scope when it is served as `/sw.js` and a cache with that scope's `kumiko-pwa-<scope hash>-` prefix exists, then deletes those caches. App-owned workers and other apps on the same origin have no such cache and stay untouched. `PWA_CACHE_NAME_PREFIX` now lives in the renderer headless entry and is re-exported by the server runtime script module.

title: Row decoration sends only new ids and keeps earlier answers
detail: In an infinite list each decoration call carries only the ids that have no answer yet; answers are merged across calls and dropped when the list's filter or sort changes. A reload after a write still asks for every id. A decoration query can now cap `ids` at the page size without losing the decoration once more pages are loaded.

title: Non-searchable entity lists ignore a stale q in the URL
detail: The entity list payload now gates `search` on the same searchable decision as the toolbar, like the projection list already did. A leftover `?q=` can no longer reach a query handler that does not accept it, and the keys sent match what the boot validator derives.

title: Renderer review fixes for file view, badge cells, dashboard lists, steps and the page editor
detail: The PDF View action and its drawer stop click propagation so a row click does not fire. A badge or button column shows the same text as the cell without display (lookup renderer, FormatSpec) and only computes it when needed. Dashboard list columns honour emptyPlaceholder false. Steps keep their further actions in their own row below sm. Payload-less write and client actions of guidance items are left out when the shown record id is unknown. Summary footer cells get unique keys. The managed-pages editor reports clean right after a successful save and computes its initial draft once.

title: Renderer review fixes for shell focus, logout and locale formatting
detail: `ShellTopbarActionsProvider` carries the shell's topbar actions in a context of its own, so `ShellFocusContext` consumers no longer re-render with every shell render and `useShellFocusHost` takes no argument. `useSetScreenFocus` only clears the focus it set itself. `clearNavCollapseState` runs on logout. The dashboard list phone line uses `dashboardListCellText` (bar as percent, i18n keys translated, `renderValue`), and the pager and the sort summary format numbers with the app locale.

title: Titled stat strip drops tiles the user may not open
detail: The strip wrapped every stat in its own cell, so a gated tile left an empty cell with a dangling separator. Gated tiles are now filtered before the cell is drawn. The dashboard card headline reuses the table's hint sentence class, the createPlacement and rowActionMode docs match the code, and TEMPLATE_EDITOR_SCREENS is read-only.

title: Long segment labels end in an ellipsis instead of being clipped by the group
detail: A segment is now at most as wide as its group, cuts its label with an ellipsis and names the full label in title. Short labels look the same and segments still wrap to the next row.

title: calendar uses the app locale and a non-overlapping header, interactive controls get a pointer cursor
detail: `CalendarDayPicker` takes month and weekday names and the week start (de starts on Monday) from the renderer locale (de, en, es, fr, it; other languages fall back to en-US). Prev/next buttons sit beside the dropdowns via `navLayout="around"` instead of absolute positioning, and the chevrons use `fill-current` with token colors. A base rule in `styles.css` sets `cursor: pointer` on enabled `button`, `[role=button]`, `[role=tab]` and `[role=menuitem]`, because Tailwind v4 preflight resets it to default.

title: List cards lead with the hint sentence
detail: `cardColumnRoles` returns a new role `lead`: the first text column with a `hint` that is neither title, status nor `hideOnNarrow`. It no longer counts as a meta column. Below 768 px the card shows the lead above the heading with the table's hint cell (sentence, detail line, "Why?"), only when the value is not empty; `rowToneField` still tints the card. The card order is now lead, title with status, up to three values, then the row action. Recipe: `samples/recipes/record-detail-layout`.

title: Cards keep their cell links tappable and focused screens show the shell's topbar actions on phones
detail: A cell link on a card with a row opener sat inside the opener button and was rendered as plain text. The MobileTopBar of a focused screen only received the overflow menu, so the shell's topbarActions were missing on phones.

title: Required fields with an entity default no longer block create forms
detail: The field-derived required check added for `RenderEdit` flagged an empty required field in create mode even when the entity declares a `default`, which the server applies on insert. Create mode now skips the presence check for such fields; update mode is unchanged.

title: editor workbench shell and a contentPreviews registry for editor previews
detail: `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/web` exports `EditorWorkbench`, `EditorFrame`, `EditorInfoBar`, `EditorBody`, `EditorHeader`, `EditorFooter`, `EditorModeSwitch`, `EditorLocaleSwitch` and the rail parts `RailSection`, `RailField`, `RailRow`, `RailHint`; the shell moved out of document-designer. `ClientFeatureDefinition.contentPreviews` registers a `PreviewRenderer` per preview target (`pdf`, `mail`, `web`, `text`), merged last-wins in createKumikoApp with a warning on a collision. `PreviewPane` mounts the renderer for a target; a target without one previews as text (`TextPreviewRenderer`). `HtmlMailFrame`, `useDebouncedValue` and `dispatcherErrorTextWithFieldIssues` are exported. New locale keys `kumiko.editor.*` are in all locale packages.

title: useFileMeta is public
detail: `useFileMeta(fileId)` returns the file name and MIME type of a file. Lookups of all cells in one render are batched into one `GET /api/files/meta` request and cached for the session, so apps can decide per row (for example "is PDF") without their own per-row request. New exports: `useFileMeta`, type `FileMeta`, and `FileViewAction` (a "view" button that opens a PDF in a drawer).

title: work-queue lists and briefing dashboards
detail: projectionList and entityList take `namedFilterFacet: { display: "select" | "chips", showCounts?, label? }`; `select` shows one single-choice dropdown and `showCounts` asks the list query once per filter for its hit count (`totalCount`). `NamedListFilterRef` gets `sort: { field, dir }` (applies while the URL carries no sort of its own, wins over `defaultSort`) and `emptyState: { title, description? }` (shown instead of the generic text when that filter yields no rows and no search is set, with a reset button). `ListColumnSpec.display` gains "button" (a column with a screen link draws a small outline button, dashboard list panels only) and "badge" now also works in the RenderList tables of entityList and projectionList, not only on dashboards; a row button in those tables stays a rowAction with `display: "button"`. The named-filter counts send the list's own payload for each filter (same filters, search, static params; no sort or paging), and defaultFilters stay off while a named filter is active. `DashboardPanelSpan` gains "third" and "two-thirds" on a 12-column grid, `DashboardListPanel.showHeader: false` drops the column header row and stacks the cells of each row below the sm breakpoint (with the header, the table keeps its normal layout), text paragraphs take `emphasis: "lead"`, and `RenderEditAction`s with `display: "link"` render as link buttons. The "Why?" of a hint column or a step opens as an inverted reason box behind an info icon (`ReasonBox`), and the sticky row-actions cell of a toned row mixes the tint into its opaque surface instead of cutting it off. New boot rules `list/named-filter-facet-without-filters`, `list/named-filter-empty-state-title-empty`, `list/button-column-without-link`, `list/button-column-in-list-table` (display "button" on a column outside dashboard list panels), `list/named-filter-sort-not-listed` and `list/named-filter-sort-not-sortable` (an entityList filter sort now reports under these instead of the defaultSort rules); `dashboard/panel-span-invalid` now lists the four spans, `named-filter/projection-query-accepts-sort` rejects a projectionList filter sort when the query schema has no `sort` and `sortDirection`, and `named-filter/projection-query-accepts-count` rejects `showCounts` when the query schema takes no `limit` and `totalCount`.

title: board gaps round 10, narrowFacets pills below sm
detail: `narrowFacets: "pills"` on `EntityListScreenDefinition` and `ProjectionListScreenDefinition`: below sm the select facets (including the namedFilter facet) render as rounded pill triggers with a stronger border; from sm up and without the option nothing changes. Boot rule `list/narrow-facets-invalid` for any other value. The record-detail-layout recipe's orders list uses it.

title: phone variants for dashboards, lists and record details
detail: Every dashboard panel takes `hideOnNarrow: true` and is left out below sm (640 px). `DashboardListPanel.narrow: { limit?, layout? }` shows only the first `limit` rows below sm, with subtitle and footer counting them ("3 of 11", "8 more"); `layout: "cards"` draws one card per row (tone stripe, badge column and `hint.detailField` on top, the bold hint sentence, other columns, button columns bottom right) and `layout: "line"` collapses the panel to one link "<label> · <first text> · <n> more" (i18n `kumiko.dashboard.list.line-more`) to `footerLink`. A text panel's query may answer `{ blocks, narrowBlocks? }` and the panel takes a static `narrowBlocks`; below sm they replace `blocks`. `DashboardStatGroupPanel.columns: 2 | 3 | 4` sets the column count of a `layout: "cards"` group from md up (one column below sm). `ListColumnHint.plainSentence: true` draws the hint sentence in the normal text color (bold) and leaves the tone to stripe, badge and detail. `showOnNarrowOnly: true` on a list column shows it on the cards only (it follows the md card switch, not sm). projectionDetail takes `summary.narrowField` (a shorter sentence below sm), `steps.narrowLimit` (the first n steps below sm and a "{count} more steps" toggle, i18n `kumiko.detail.steps.more.one`, `kumiko.detail.steps.more.other` and `kumiko.detail.steps.less`) and `progress.hideOnNarrow`; a chain placed `beside-steps` shows "Step k of n" (`kumiko.detail.progress.step-of`) under its title. `RecordSummaryProps.narrowText`, `RecordStepsProps.narrowLimit`, `moreLabel` and `lessLabel` carry these into custom primitives. Visible change: a hint's `reasonField` now stays behind its info toggle in the table, in the cards and in the row-open first cell (before, that cell showed the reason open); the first cell of a clickable row opens the row from the sentence only. Step and banner actions already honor `display: "link"` and `style`. New boot rules `dashboard/list-narrow-invalid`, `dashboard/list-narrow-line-without-footer-link`, `dashboard/stat-group-columns-invalid`, `dashboard/stat-group-child-hide-on-narrow`, `dashboard/text-narrow-blocks-without-blocks`, `list/narrow-only-conflict`, `projection-detail/steps-narrow-limit-invalid`; `query/output-field-missing` also checks `summary.narrowField`. The detail head now has a title block under the breadcrumb (title, status chip, grey subtitle), steps show a count and a small main action on the title row with further actions below the detail, banners get a tone icon and a small action, and card buttons are small and left-aligned. The shell header then shows the parent crumb instead of the record title (`PageHeaderProps.bodyTitle`), so the document keeps one h1. `table.summaryRow` items may omit `label` and show the value alone. `DashboardCustomPanel.span` sets the grid width like the other panels. Dashboard "As of" and relative times follow the server clock (every query answer carries the app clock `ctx.clock` as an ISO instant with whole milliseconds in the header `X-Kumiko-Now`, set before the body is read on every dispatcher route, so a fixed test or screenshot clock shows; the renderer falls back to the `Date` header, then to the device clock). A focused screen keeps the app's `headerActions` (assistant button) in the shell header; sidebar trigger and notification bell still leave. Step and banner actions take `hideIcon: true` (icon stays registered for the `screen/action-icon` rule, only not drawn). `DashboardStatPanel.labelField` and `MetricSpec.labelField` read the label from the query field (the static `label` stays the fallback); `query/output-field-missing` checks both.

title: board gaps round 5, phone and desktop details
detail: Dashboard "As of" is now the server date and hidden below sm (i18n `kumiko.dashboard.updated-at` is removed). A titled `stat-group` strip draws one box per stat from sm up; below sm one line "<title> · <n> <narrowLabel ?? label>" with the new `DashboardStatPanel.narrowLabel` (stats inside a group only) and `DashboardStatGroupPanel.icon`. Stat value and sub line share one baseline; metrics with `navigate` get a small arrow; `MetricSpec.hideOnNarrow`. Every panel takes `narrowOrder` (integer of at least 0, stable sort below sm). `DashboardListPanel.showTotal` is `true | { text?, narrowText? }` (`{shown}`, `{total}`); `footerLink.moreText` and `narrowMoreText` (`{count}`); `narrow: { layout: "line", field? }`; `rowLink: { screen, paramField?, icon?: "arrow" | "chevron" }` makes table rows links with a small icon at the right edge (cards get none; i18n `kumiko.dashboard.list.open-row`). `showOnNarrowOnly` is now allowed in dashboard lists; `ListColumnHint.narrowDetailField` replaces the detail on cards. Dashboard list cards below sm: badge plus one-line detail, bold sentence, `showOnNarrowOnly` columns left and a small button right, no info toggle. Entity and projection list cards: description, column picker and export are hidden below sm, a hint reason has no toggle on cards, each text column sits on its own line, row actions are small outlined buttons bottom left (also `display: "link"`). Visible change: the reason of a hint is no longer reachable on cards. `table.summaryRow` items take `column` and draw as a table row with the values under their columns. Shell below sm: app `headerActions` wrapped in `HeaderActionPinned` (new, from renderer/web) stay next to the bell; the other actions fold into the "…" menu. The record file shows "<parent> › <short title> + status chip" in the top bar from md (`header.shortTitle`, a query field, falls back to the record title); below sm the focus top bar reads "‹ <parent>" (the parent list title replaces the record title as the back label) and the breadcrumb line is gone. `header.narrowSubtitle` (query field) replaces the subtitle below sm. `RecordGuidanceAction.narrowLabel` (button text below sm), banners draw on one line (title, text, button right; title and button only below sm), `RecordStep.narrowDetail`, step subtitle hidden below sm, the main step action honors `display: "link"` and `hideIcon`, further actions sit as text links on the title row (hidden below sm). StepBar stage list gets a chain look (vertical connector, filled check when done, ring with dot for the current step in the warn tone, empty ring when open, no numbers). New boot rules `dashboard/list-narrow-field-unknown`, `dashboard/narrow-order-invalid`, `dashboard/stat-narrow-label-outside-group`, `dashboard/stat-group-icon-without-titled-strip`, `dashboard/list-row-link-invalid`, `list/narrow-detail-field-without-detail-field`; the rule that rejected `showOnNarrowOnly` in dashboards is gone. Visible change: banner icons are now "info" for every tone. Breaking: `StatStripCell.compact` is removed (public export of renderer/web). `StatCard` shows the arrow for every `link`, dashboard stats included. The `moreActions` of a step are not reachable below sm.

title: board gaps round 6, dashboard rows, list headers, filters and pagination
detail: Dashboard panel heads put title and description on one line from sm. A titled stat strip bundles its boxes on the left (12px gap) with the link at the right; below sm the numbers are bold in text color. Dashboard list rows from sm: a leading badge column sits inline before the title, the meta line below, 12px row padding. New list options: `rowLink: { screenField, paramsField?, icon? }` (target screen from a query field; `screen` and `screenField` exclude each other, so `DashboardListRowLink.screen` is now optional when read; no app in the workspace reads it), `DashboardListPanel.icon` (extension component for the phone line), `narrow.moreText` (`{count}`), `narrow.titleField` (card title below sm), `rowToneMarker: "bar" | "dot"`, `narrow.field` may be any query output field (not only a column) and `footerLink.narrowOnly` (no footer link from sm, but the target of the phone line). New boot rules for these fields (`footerLink.narrowOnly` needs `narrow.layout: "line"`; a query without `outputSchema` falls back to the panel columns for `narrow.*`, `rowLink.screenField` and `paramsField`; `dashboard/list-narrow-field-unknown` now checks the query output; `query/output-field-missing` covers `rowLink.screenField`, `paramsField`, `narrow.titleField`). The dashboard header date follows the app clock of the server answer. Tables: column headers in small caps from sm; a `linkScreenField` or `display: "button"` action column is right-aligned with a screen-reader-only header from sm; a `linkScreenField` column stays a text link in the table, on cards it draws as a small outline button. Select filters read "<label>: All" when empty (i18n `kumiko.list.filter.all`); below sm (not below md) select-only filters are wrapping chips under the search and the filter icon button is dropped; the card sort line below sm reads "Sorted by <option> ↓ · <n> <noun>" (i18n `kumiko.list.sort.summary`, the count in the locale's number format). Pagination from sm: "1–10 of 26 · 10 per page" left, "‹ 1 2 3 ›" with the current page marked right (i18n `kumiko.pager.goToPage`; the unused key `kumiko.pager.pageOf` is removed from the catalogs, the arrows are 28px from sm); below sm "1–10 of 26" with arrows. Record file: `hideIcon` holds for the narrow label variant of step and banner actions, the step (i) icons are hidden below sm, a step action with `display: "link"` draws as a text link (it was overridden by `style`). Serif body text (dashboard lead paragraph, record summary) is 16px below sm.

title: board gaps round 7, reason box, toolbar options, compact steps
detail: Hint reason box: `ListColumnHint.reasonOpenField` (boolean row field) opens the `reasonField` text from sm as a dark box under the row across the full row width (the (i) stays and closes it; cards below sm keep the toggle), `ListColumnHint.reasonTitleField` adds a bold lead-in; `RecordStep.whyOpen` and `RecordStep.whyTitle` do the same under a step. The box uses the sidebar theme tokens, 12.5px text, an arrow at the top left; the opened toggle uses the same look. Boot rule `list/reason-option-without-reason-field`; the new fields are checked by `query/output-field-missing`. Stat-group: cards layout puts title and description on one line from sm; `narrow: { tone }` tints the one-line phone strip of a titled strip (boot rules `dashboard/stat-group-narrow-without-titled-strip` and `dashboard/stat-group-narrow-tone-invalid`); numbers in every narrow line are plain, not bold. `rowToneMarker: "dot"` centers the dot on the first text line. Badge columns take `badgeDot: false` for a pill without dot. Lists: `RowActionMode` "menu" puts all row actions in the kebab (cards below sm draw no kebab), `EntityListScreenDefinition.createPlacement: "toolbar"` moves the create button to the end of the filter row from sm (boot rule `entity-list/create-placement-without-create`), `EntityListScreenDefinition.toolbarSort: true` adds a "Sorted by" select to the filter row from sm (boot rule `entity-list/toolbar-sort-without-sort-options`), `itemNounKey` on `ProjectionListScreenDefinition` and `EntityListScreenDefinition` sets the noun of the card sort line. The card sort line below sm has no trailing chevron, and `summaryRow` is rendered only from sm. Record steps: the count in the steps header shows only below sm; below sm steps are compact rows with a 3px tone stripe, 14px title, 12px detail, a small outline action button and 10px gaps, the "more steps" line has a border-colored stripe. Every list row with a `reasonField` now owns its reason state: the opened toggle stands as a full-width row under the row (one look, replaces the in-cell box), with no divider line between row and box. The box is open by default only in the table view (entity/projection lists from `md`, dashboard lists from `sm`); cards keep the plain toggle. New public props: `StatusBadge.dot` (false leaves the dot out), `DataTableProps.toolbarSort`, `RenderListProps.toolbarSort`. Stat-group cards use the shared panel head (`PanelShell`) so title and description sit on one line from sm; frame and spacing follow the other panels. Between sm and md the sort select of the toolbar replaces the card sort bar when `toolbarSort` is set; the create button of `createPlacement: "toolbar"` starts at md (the compact header below md keeps its "+"). In "menu" mode a phone card without a row target keeps its kebab. Serif body text (dashboard lead paragraph, record summary) is 15.5px/1.5 below sm (was 16px).

title: board gaps round 8, list card frame, toolbar actions placement, opener in the kebab
detail: `ListTableOptions.frame: "card"` (entityList, projectionList and relatedList `table` block): from sm the table, summary row and pager sit in one bordered, rounded card with the pager at the card's end (toolbar and description stay above it); below sm the cards of the card layout are bordered, rounded cards with a gap and the tone stripe inside the card. Default unchanged (table frameless over the page width, pager at the page end); boot rule `list-table/frame-invalid`. `toolbarActionsPlacement: "toolbar"` on `EntityListScreenDefinition` and `ProjectionListScreenDefinition`: from md the `toolbarActions` end the filter row after the "Sorted by" select and the create button (primary actions with a plus icon) instead of standing in the page header; below md they stay in the header; boot rule `list/toolbar-actions-placement-without-actions`. `ProjectionListScreenDefinition.toolbarSort: true` now exists like on entity lists (boot rule `entity-list/toolbar-sort-without-sort-options` covers both). `rowActionMode: "menu"` keeps the row opener (`rowClick: true`) as an entry in the kebab, so every row has a kebab even when the opener is the only action; "adaptive" and "inline" are unchanged. New density level `relaxed` (`table.density.default`, view menu entry "Weit"/"Relaxed"): body cells get `py-3` from sm, the header row is unchanged. The record-detail-layout recipe's orders list uses `frame: "card"`.

title: board gaps round 9, projection money alignment, emptyPlaceholder, toolbar icon, dimmed to-do sentence
detail: projectionList and relatedList columns with `valueType: "money"` or `"number"` now synthesize a real number/money field, so header and cells are right-aligned like in an entityList (before, every projection column was typed as text and stayed left). `ListColumnSpec.emptyPlaceholder: false` leaves an empty cell blank instead of drawing the em dash (boot rule `list/hint-column-empty-placeholder` rejects it together with `hint`, which owns its own empty look). `ToolbarAction.icon` (an `IconKey`) is now honored by every toolbar action builder, so a relatedList tab toolbar draws the declared icon like the main list; without it the id-derived default (create, delete, ...) still applies. A hint column whose `toneField` row value is `neutral` draws the sentence muted and not bold, like `emptyLabel`, in the table, on the phone card (no tone stripe) and in dashboard list cards; `plainSentence: true` opts out.

title: board gaps in lists, dashboards and record details
detail: A toned row (`rowTone`, `rowToneField`) now draws a 3px stripe on the left instead of filling the row. `sortOptions: [{ field, dir, label }]` on projectionList and entityList adds a "Sorted by" select to the toolbar (and the card layout, replacing the per-column entries; i18n key `kumiko.list.sort.prefix`). `table.summaryRow: { query }` (projectionList and entityList) shows a line of "label value" pairs from that query under the rows; the query gets the list's filters and search. A hint column's `width` and `minWidth` apply without `table.resizing`. Below 768 px a rowAction with `display: "button"` renders as an outline button at the bottom right of the card. `DashboardListPanel` gets `subtitle`, `showTotal` ("n of m" from the query's `total`) and `footerLink: { label, screen, namedFilter?, params? }`; `DashboardStatGroupPanel` gets `layout: "cards" | "strip"` (a labelless group with `layout: "cards"` renders the cards grid without a heading) and `link: { label, screen }`. Visible changes: a dashboard StatCard with a `tone` colours its value and draws the same left stripe (warn uses the status-warn colour), a toned table row draws its stripe as an inset shadow that also holds on a pinned first column, and the detail progress cards and banner share the summary's px-6 inset. The summary row sits in the same tfoot as the totals. A card with a tone stripe gives up 3px of left padding. Also, `setupTestStack` returns the manual clock as `stack.clock`, and an invalid `now` string fails with a clear message. `metricsPlacement.narrow` moves only the metric tiles, in both the page header and the head card. A dashboard stat tile with a `tone` draws the same left stripe, and `MetricSpec.subField` shows a second line under a metric value. A dashboard stat's `navigate` may target a custom screen (no `namedFilter`). projectionDetail takes `metricsPlacement: { narrow: "after-guidance" }` (below md the metrics follow the summary and steps) and `progress.placement: "beside-steps"` (the chains become a stacked stage list in a 4/12 column next to the steps from lg); `StepBar` gets `orientation: "stacked"`. `setupTestStack({ now })` starts the stack with a manual clock at that instant (string or Temporal.Instant); `extraContext.clock` still wins. New boot rules `list/sort-options-invalid`, `list/sort-options-default-not-listed`, `list/sort-option-not-sortable`, `list/summary-row-shape`, `list/summary-row-query-unknown`, `list/summary-row-query-accepts-list-keys`, `dashboard/panel-link-target`, `dashboard/stat-navigate-custom-with-filter`, `list/summary-row-on-related-list`, `list/summary-row-with-totals` (a table keeps summaryRow or totals, not both), `projection-detail/progress-beside-steps-without-steps`; `list-table/column-width-without-resizing` no longer applies to hint columns; `query/output-field-missing` also checks `MetricSpec.subField`.

title: row tone, hint column and record guidance blocks
detail: entityList and projectionList take `rowToneField` (row tint from a tone field). A column takes `hint: { detailField?, toneField?, reasonField?, emptyLabel? }` for a sentence cell with detail line, tone and a "Why?" toggle (shown open when the cell sits inside a row-open button), plus `linkParamsField` next to `linkScreenField`. projectionDetail takes `breadcrumb`, `summary`, `banner` and `steps`, each reading a field of the query row; `banner.actions` and `steps.actions` are evaluated against the notice or step like list rows. Dashboard list panels accept `rowToneField`, `hint`, `linkScreenField` and `linkParamsField`, text panels accept a `query` (static `blocks` stay as fallback), and `navigate.params` on stat panels. New optional web primitives `RecordBreadcrumb`, `RecordSummary`, `RecordSteps` (fallbacks from the core primitives), new i18n keys `kumiko.list.hint.empty|reason` and `kumiko.detail.steps.title|empty|reason`, `kumiko.detail.breadcrumb` (en, de, es, fr, it), new boot rules `list/hint-column-renderer`, `list/hint-column-display`, `list/hint-column-link`, `list/link-params-without-screen-field`, `list/guidance-field-empty`, `projection-detail/guidance-field-empty`, `projection-detail/guidance-action-show-on-tabs`, `dashboard/stat-navigate-params-invalid`.

title: rowDecoration on entityList and projectionList, MetricSpec.toneField
detail: entityList and projectionList take `rowDecoration: { query, params? }`. After every page answer the list calls `query` once with `{ ...params, ids }` (`ids` are the loaded row ids in row order; with infinite pagination all accumulated rows, in grouped mode the rows of the open groups) and merges the answer `{ rows: [{ id, ...fields }] }` into the rows; decoration fields win over same-named row fields, malformed entries and foreign ids are ignored. The list never waits for the decoration and shows plain rows while it loads or fails. `rowToneField`, column `hint`, `linkScreenField`/`linkParamsField`, rowAction `visible`/`params`/`payload` and entityList columns (plain text, label from `label` or the field label key) can read decoration fields. `MetricSpec.toneField` names a record field holding a SelectOptionTone that overrides `tone` (also at value 0; empty or unknown values fall back to `tone`). New boot rules `list/row-decoration-query-empty` and `list/row-decoration-ids-missing`; the decoration query must be registered (`query/not-registered`), its outputSchema fields count as known row fields, and `metrics.toneField` is checked like `summary.toneField`.

title: sidebar nav no longer re-expands collapsed containers on screen change
detail: The collapsed set of `NavTree` was component state that reset whenever the shell remounted the sidebar (focus mode, mobile sheet). It is now kept in sessionStorage (`kumiko.nav.collapsed`, access wrapped in try/catch). Navigating to a screen opens the containers on its path and no other collapsed container; the search filter still opens everything temporarily and restores the stored state when cleared.

title: pwa option: basePath for apps served under a path prefix
detail: `PwaOptions` gets `basePath` (default `/`, must start and end with `/`, same-origin, no empty, `.` or `..` segment, no `?` or `#`, otherwise the boot fails). The manifest is answered at `${basePath}manifest.webmanifest` and the worker at `${basePath}sw.js` (a worker only controls its own directory), `start_url`, `scope` and `id` are the base path, the shell precache and the offline fallback use `${basePath}`, and the head tags point at the prefixed paths; `/assets/*` stays at the root and cache-first, and so do the API paths (`/api`, `/sse`, `/auth`), so the ingress must route those to the app too. Each base path gets its own cache name prefix, so apps on one origin do not delete each other's precache. The web client registers the worker with the directory of the URL in `<meta name="kumiko-pwa-sw">` as scope instead of a fixed `/`. With the default base path nothing changes. `PWA_MANIFEST_PATH` and `PWA_SERVICE_WORKER_PATH` are no longer exported. Recipe: `samples/recipes/pwa-shell`.

title: pwa option: web manifest, own service worker, one-time install hint
detail: `runProdApp`, `runDevApp` and `createKumikoServer` take `pwa: { name, shortName, themeColor, backgroundColor, icons: [{ src, sizes, type?, purpose? }] }` (type `PwaOptions` from `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-server-runtime/pwa`); pass it to both servers. Icon `src` must be a same-origin path, otherwise the boot fails; in production `pwa` needs `staticDir`. The server answers `GET /manifest.webmanifest` (`application/manifest+json`) and a generated `GET /sw.js` (`no-cache`), both ahead of app routes and files, and adds manifest link, theme-color, Apple home-screen tags, apple-touch-icon and `<meta name="kumiko-pwa-sw">` to every HTML shell. The worker precaches `/`, manifest, icons and the build's bundles under a cache name derived from build id, bundles and options, serves `/assets/*` cache-first, other shell files network-first, navigations network-first with the cached shell only when offline, and never handles `/api/`, `/sse/`, `/auth/`, SSE, non-GET or cross-origin requests; activate drops older `kumiko-pwa-` caches. The web client registers the worker only when the meta is present and shows a dismissible one-time install hint (iOS: Share then Add to Home Screen; elsewhere the deferred `beforeinstallprompt`), never when running standalone. New i18n keys `kumiko.pwa.install-hint`, `kumiko.pwa.install-hint-ios`, `kumiko.pwa.install`, `kumiko.pwa.dismiss` in en, de, es, fr, it. Without `pwa` nothing changes and existing service workers stay registered. `/manifest.json` remains the build's asset map. Recipe: `samples/recipes/pwa-shell`.

title: Record progress block for projection detail screens
detail: projectionDetail takes `progress: { field }`; the query returns `RecordProgress[]` (`title`, `steps` with `id`, `label`, `done`, optional `detail`, and `currentIndex`) in that field. Each chain renders as a step bar between the banner and the steps panel, with done steps marked and the current step as "up next". An empty array hides the block, and boot validation rejects an empty field name (`projection-detail/guidance-field-empty`).

title: cardRenderer removed from entityList and projectionList
detail: `cardRenderer` was declared and passed through but never rendered; the narrow layout always drew the default card from the column roles. The field is gone from `EntityListScreenDefinition` and `ProjectionListScreenDefinition`.
migration: Remove the field; cards follow the column roles `highlighted`, `hideOnNarrow` and `hint`.

title: RenderEdit validates required fields, with or without a custom schema
detail: Required fields were only checked client-side when the form schema came from `buildFormSchema` (default entity screens). Every other `RenderEdit` treated the form as valid, and a caller `schema` replaced the field checks, so an empty required field was submitted and failed on the server without a field error. `RenderEdit` now always runs the field-derived required checks and merges their issues with those of a caller `schema`, for `controller.submit()` and `customSubmit`; hidden fields stay exempt. The `valid` flag of `onChange` includes the required fields as well, so forms such as actionForms that relied on the handler to reject an empty required field now block on the client. Select fields with an entity `default` are exempt when creating, because the server fills an empty select from the default.

title: DashboardTextPanel: blocks optional, text and items accept i18n objects
migration: Consumers that read panel.blocks or block.text as plain strings: use blocks ?? [] and check typeof text === 'string' (DashboardText is string | i18n object).

title: stale async answers, silent input loss and missing dashboard links
detail: Notification inbox `loadMore`, presence heartbeats and related-list tab counts drop answers that a newer request or refetch superseded, and tab badges no longer show the previous record's numbers. A running upload in a draft wizard now asks before leaving. The SSE stall watchdog only arms on `open`, so a cold-start handshake is no longer aborted. A drawer redirect onto the open record of its own projectionDetail no longer navigates. Embedded-list stored references are looked up in one chunk within the list limit. Dashboard list reference cells link to the target detail screen. `StatusBadgeTone` now aliases `StatusBadgeOptionTone`; `isSessionEndedUploadError` is removed in favor of `isSessionEndedCause`.

title: InfinityList live refresh state is local to its effect
detail: The disposed, in-flight and trailing flags of the live first-page refresh belong to one effect run, so a payload change or unmount no longer lets the previous run schedule another query.

title: bulk selection no longer keeps hidden rows after an empty result
detail: `useRowSelection` skipped pruning whenever the list was empty, so rows selected before a filter hit zero results reappeared selected once the filter was lifted, and hidden ids counted toward the 100-row limit. Pruning now only skips the empty gap right after a bulk run retained its failed rows, and `isFull` and the toggle limit count loaded rows only.

title: Banner keeps unique keys
detail: The renderer Banner keeps unique keys for repeated identical parts. The files dropzone shows a fallback text (kumiko.field.dropzone.file-unavailable, all locales) for a file without meta instead of an endless placeholder.

title: lists hold their queries while remembered params are restored
detail: With `rememberState`, a list opened without URL params fetched once with the defaults (rows, groups, totals) before the stored params reached the URL, and showed the unfiltered list for a moment. `useRememberedListParams` now returns `restoring`, and the row and aggregate queries wait until the restored URL arrived. A file dropzone shows the file name of a value the form already held (resolved through the file meta cache) instead of the FileRef id, via the new `UploadZone` prop `labelForValue`. Clearing a stored money amount in an edit form is no longer stripped silently from the submit; the server answers it visibly. The three-column editor body keeps the DOM order left rail, page, right rail and places the rails by grid.

title: fixed FloatingPanel width accounts for the right offset
detail: The fixed placement limited the width to `100vw` minus twice the margin and ignored `rightPx`, so a panel anchored beside a sidebar (for example `right: 364px` at a 768px viewport) lost its left edge, title and header actions. The width is now `min(widthPx, calc(100vw - (rightPx + margin)))`, like the height with `bottomPx`.

title: Named-filter chips and dashboard tiles hide filters the session roles may not use
detail: `NamedListFilterRef` gains the optional `roles`, set only by the framework from the access rule of the entity's named filter when the client schema is built (open and signed-in-only filters carry none). The list chip row skips chips whose roles do not overlap the session roles, and a dashboard stat tile whose `navigate.namedFilter` targets such a filter is not rendered and sends no count query. Refs of projection-list screens carry no roles because their entity is unknown to the schema build.

title: code input, collapsible header, column drag and overflow error polish
detail: `CollapsibleSection` uses `min-h-9` so long titles are not clipped. `CodeInput` discards a change that would insert digits into an already full code, so no shifted code reaches `onComplete`. The column picker drag calls `onChange` only when the target index moves. Data table header cells carry `data-column-role` for width measurement instead of relying on test ids. Overflow-menu action errors render only while the action lives in the overflow menu. The list export no longer strips paging keys client-side; `sanitizeExportPayload` on the server is the only trust boundary.

title: list state, reference lookup, live refresh and upload tracking races fixed
detail: `referenceRowsByIdsPayload` caps `limit` at the server maximum so a field with more than 200 ids still resolves labels. `sanitizeStoredListState` keeps the `filter` param. `useListViewState` stores only pins and widths that differ from the schema defaults, so later schema changes still reach users who only changed density. Group page bridges remount on `resetKey`, `InfinityList` drops its trailing live refresh once its effect is disposed, and `UploadZone` accepts `trackUpload` so the dropzone tracks resize and upload together. Uniform bar controls keep `h-11` below md, embedded card attachments respect `isHiddenInRow`, and two or more promoted toolbar actions without a create button use the phone overflow menu.

title: screen focus seam and user-owned sidebar state
detail: `ScreenFocusProvider` (mounted by `DefaultAppShell` and `WorkspaceShell`), `useSetScreenFocus(focus)` and `useScreenFocus()` let a screen report `{ entityName, recordId, label, facts? }`, compared by value and cleared on unmount; the PDF template editor reports its template. `useShellFocusMode()` no longer collapses or restores the sidebar. The sidebar's open state is kept in localStorage (`kumiko.sidebar.open`) and changes only through the user's own clicks; a collapsed sidebar on a focus screen still shows the focus rail.

title: Declarative focus for record screens
detail: `focus?: boolean` on `projectionDetail` and `entityEdit` (default off). A focused screen calls `useShellFocusMode()` for the renderer: the focus rail replaces the full sidebar and the app header actions leave the shell header. Below 768 px the shell header is hidden and the screen gets a `MobileTopBar` with the record title (screen title as fallback), a back arrow to the parent list screen (same resolution as the breadcrumb, browser history without a parent) and the page-header overflow items as menu. Recipe: `samples/recipes/record-detail-layout`.

title: Segmented control labels wrap instead of overlapping in narrow columns
detail: Segments of the select segment control kept their longest word as minimum width and spilled into the neighbouring segment. Segments now shrink to their column (`minmax(0,1fr)`, `min-w-0`) and break long words.

title: Edit forms wait for running file uploads before submitting
detail: The submit button of an edit form stays disabled while a file upload (dropzone, single file or image, embedded list cell) is running, and `handleSubmit` returns early in that window, so Enter, save-and-close and draft save cannot send the form without the attachment either. Custom upload widgets can join the lock with `useTrackFormUpload()` from the renderer; outside a form it just runs the upload.

title: Consecutive top-level nav entries without a section share one list
detail: NavTree rendered every top-level entry that is not a section (screen leaves, provider nodes such as Content) in its own list, so the 12px gap between blocks also opened between two such entries. Consecutive entries now form one list with the 1px item gap; only sections and runs of entries are separated by the block gap. A run whose entries are all filtered out by the search is hidden.

title: StepList selection with prerequisites, compact Banner, fixed FloatingPanel
detail: `StepList` takes an optional `selection` (`selectedIds`, `onSelectionChange`, `actions`). It adds a checkbox per step, a "Select all" row with a count ("2 selected, 1 waiting for input") and, while something is selected, footer actions labelled with the count whose `onClick` receives the effective selection in list order. A step's `dependsOn` lists prerequisites: selecting the step selects them too (marked "Also selected: needed for …"), and unselecting a prerequisite drops the steps that need it. `selectable` per step is `{ kind: "selectable" }`, `{ kind: "missing-input", reason }` (checkbox disabled, "Input missing" tag) or `{ kind: "none" }` (no checkbox), so an app can keep risky steps out of bulk actions. A step whose open prerequisite cannot be selected is disabled with "Review “…” on its own first". Without `selection` the list renders as before. `Banner` takes `density: "compact"` (one line, title inline), `icon` (a nav icon key) and the variant `"ok"` for a finished state. `FloatingPanel` takes `placement: { mode: "fixed", rightPx, bottomPx, widthPx, heightPx }` (anchored, no drag, no resize, nothing persisted), `bodyLayout: "fill"` (children pad and scroll themselves) and `surface: "ai"`. New exports: `StepSelectability`, `StepSelectionAction`, `StepListSelection`, `FloatingPanelPlacement`, plus `usePresence`, `usePresenceList`, `PresenceNotice`, `PresenceAvatars`; `Avatar` takes `size: "xs"` and `shape: "round"`.

title: projectionDetail renders no empty header band
detail: A projectionDetail whose `header.subtitle` field is empty and that has no metrics no longer renders an empty subtitle row or an empty metrics band (extra padding and height). Applies to all apps.

title: Heading variant "group"
detail: `Heading variant="group"` renders a 16px semibold sub-title in the foreground color, normal case. The default `page` is unchanged.

title: DetailList valueWeight and sidebar layout
detail: `DetailList valueWeight="normal"` drops the value emphasis (default `"medium"`). `layout="sidebar"` puts a narrow label column and the value on one row for side columns (default `"default"`).

title: TextareaField placeholder, Composer widget
detail: `TextareaField` takes a `placeholder`. New `Composer` chat input: label-less textarea with the send button inside the field frame, bottom right. Props `value`, `onChange`, `onSubmit`, `placeholder`, `disabled`, `submitLabel` (text of the send button), `docked`, `rows`.

title: ModeSwitch option disabled and tone
detail: A `ModeSwitch` option can be `disabled` (not selectable, `aria-disabled`, muted) and carry `tone: "warning"` (warning frame) to flag an open question.

title: Banner icon and structured parts
detail: `Banner` takes an optional leading `icon` (a nav icon key such as `"alert-triangle"`) and `parts: [{ text, strong? }]` rendered after `children`; `children` is now optional. No markup strings.

title: SectionNavLayout widget
detail: `SectionNavLayout` wraps custom or extension sections in a column with the "On this page" list (`FormSectionNav`). Props `items`, `children`, `width`, `testId`. Stacked forms already render the list themselves.

title: Wizard intro follows the current step
detail: The intro text beside the wizard rail now follows the description of the current step and falls back to `formSubtitle`; the description above the fields is shown only below `lg`, where the rail is hidden (without a rail it stays in the section header). Applies to every app that uses a wizard with a step rail.

title: Studio visual round: ChoiceCards, ModeSwitch, SideBySideTable, Banner, FormSectionNav options
detail: Opt-in only, defaults unchanged. `ChoiceCards` takes `columns` (1 to 4), `variant="radio"` and `label`. `ModeSwitch` takes `segmentWidth="wide"`. `SideBySideTable` takes `rowHeaderTone="foreground"`. `Banner` takes `actionsPlacement="below"`. `FormSectionNav` takes `activeTone="foreground"`.

title: Wizard step rail wraps text and hides the active subtitle
detail: Step rail rows wrap long labels and subtitles instead of truncating them. The active step shows no subtitle in the rail (below `lg`, where the rail is hidden, the section header shows the text). Applies to every wizard with a step rail.

title: Composer text button and docked option, ModeSwitch frame, DetailList sidebar, SectionNavLayout marker
detail: `Composer` renders a text send button (`submitLabel` is its text), the textarea on the normal background without a surrounding strip, and takes `docked`: sticky at the bottom of a scroll container that carries the screen padding, pushed down with `mt-auto` in a full-height flex column. `ModeSwitch` `tone: "warning"` frames the whole switch. `DetailList layout="sidebar"` left-aligns the value. `SectionNavLayout` marks the active entry bold in the text colour. These widgets are new in this release.

title: hideRequiredMarker reaches widget fields, ModeSwitch on the input surface
detail: `layout.hideRequiredMarker` now also hides the asterisk of `Field`-based widgets in custom and extension sections (`aria-required` stays). The outline `ModeSwitch` uses the text input's background (`bg-transparent`, `dark:bg-input/30`) instead of `bg-background`, so unselected segments match inputs on every app.

title: Banner actions below the text keep a gap
detail: With `actionsPlacement: "below"` the action buttons wrap in a row with `gap-2` instead of touching each other.

title: actionForm summary params
detail: `summary.params` (`Record<string, string>`) of an actionForm screen interpolates fixed values, such as an app name a feature option sets, into the summary title and subtitle. They are merged with the formatted drawer prefill and win on a name clash.

title: actionForm successItems, Banner variant hint
detail: An actionForm can declare successItems { field, link? }. After a successful submit every entry of that payload array with a string label is shown as its own hint (Banner variant "hint", muted background) with the link on the right; the link resolves like a success link, but idFrom and params read from the entry. While at least one hint is shown it replaces the generic confirmation text. Boot rejects successItems together with redirect and an unknown link target; the role projection drops a link into a screen the role cannot reach and keeps the hints.

title: Read-only email and phone text fields render as mailto and tel links
detail: A read-only text field with `format: "email"` renders its value as a `mailto:` link and `format: "phone"` as a `tel:` link through the Link primitive. The `tel:` href keeps digits and a leading `+` only; empty values and phone values without a digit stay plain text. `isSafeHref` now also accepts `tel:`, which the Link primitive and the markdown renderer share.

title: configEdit actions: handler buttons between the form fields
detail: `ConfigEditScreenDefinition.actions` takes `{ id, handler, label, description?, buttonLabel, afterField, successMessage? }`. The button renders as its own row directly after `afterField`, calls the write handler with `{}` and never saves the form; it is disabled with the hint `kumiko.configEdit.action.saveFirst` (de, en, es, fr, it) while the form has unsaved changes. Success and failure go through the action notifier, with a banner as fallback. The boot validator checks that the handler is a registered write handler, that `afterField` is a layout field and that ids are unique.

title: projectionDetail: formatted header subtitle parts and email/phone fields
detail: A `header.subtitle` part `{ field, format }` formats the value with a `FormatSpec` before it is shown. A projectionDetail layout field `{ field, format: "email" | "phone" }` renders its read-only value as a `mailto:` or `tel:` link, like an entity text field with that format.

title: actionForm summary box on screen forms; detail subtitle and notes use the active locale
detail: An actionForm screen with `summary` now renders the context box under the title also when it is a full screen, not only in a drawer. Header subtitle parts with a `format` and the notes section format dates with the active locale (`formatWhen(value, locale?)`; without a locale the old default stays).

title: "On this page" navigation lists related-list and extension sections
detail: The section navigation next to a screen form (entityEdit, projectionDetail) now also lists titled `relatedList` and `extension` sections, not only field sections, and scrolls to them. A section whose title equals the screen title is still left out.

title: Stored write-only secrets show a masked "set" row with Replace
detail: A write-only field whose value is set (secrets, `writeOnly` entity fields) now renders "•••••••••• set" and a Replace button instead of the empty input. Replace reveals the input (with Remove stored value and the keep-placeholder); after a save the masked row returns. New translation keys `kumiko.field.writeOnly.maskedSet` and `kumiko.field.writeOnly.replace` (de, en, es, fr, it).

title: Saved secrets leave the form state; email and phone links are underlined; lists format times in the active locale
detail: After a successful configEdit or secrets save, a typed write-only value is replaced by the "set" marker instead of staying as plaintext in the form state. Read-only email and phone values render as underlined links. The delivery time column and the document-designer overview, version list and overrides drawer format times with the active locale.

title: Focus rail with user menu and a "More" tile
detail: A focused screen's icon rail now pins the shell's sidebarFooter (for example the sidebar UserMenu) to its bottom, so profile and logout stay reachable. WorkspaceShell and DefaultAppShell take focusRailNavQns, the top-level nav QNs the rail shows as tiles; the other entries sit behind a "More" tile that opens the full sidebar and is marked active when the current screen lives there. New nav icon keys "warehouse" and "euro". An HTML mail whose quote is folded drops the Gmail separator break and the last paragraph's bottom margin, so the quote toggle sits right under the signature.

title: Screen forms with declared columns pack fields in flow again
detail: Since the declared-columns change a screen form with columns >= 2 rendered as a real CSS grid, so narrow fields (date, select) sat in wide columns and the second column started mid-form. Flow layout is back for every form with flow set and ignores the declared column count, as before. The view-model field columnsDeclared is removed; select width sm:w-60 and full-width cells stay.

title: Tab content sits 16px below the tab strip
detail: projectionDetail with layout.mode tabs left about 10px between the tab strip and the tab content (the embedded list toolbar). The header region wrapper now tops that up to 16px in one place for every tab kind.

title: Chromeless screen panels in dashboards carry a section head
detail: A dashboard panel kind screen with chromeless renders the embedded screen's title (panel label, else screen:<id>.title) and its translated description as a section head, separated from the previous panel by a divider and without extra indentation. The embedded form no longer renders its own title block, and its submit buttons sit left-aligned directly under the fields without a divider footer. The "All fields are required" hint needs at least two shown fields, a lone field keeps its own required mark. The "As of" stamp only shows when the dashboard has a panel that loads data (not only screen, text or custom panels). The account-security dashboard marks its panels chromeless, and the sessions screen my-sessions is now titled "Signed-in devices" with a description (de, en, es, fr, it).

title: PdfViewer pagesOnly fits whole pages, ThreadMessage.teaser
detail: PdfViewer with pagesOnly now scales each page to the scroller's content height as well as its width (shrink-only), so a search hit opened in a host shows the page whole. ThreadMessage gains an optional teaser: while a foldOlderTogether thread has the mail closed, the plain-text teaser is shown clamped to clampLines lines with the "Read the whole mail" button; a click shows the full body. On phones StepList text and step buttons are 14px, its status icons 20px, and StatusBadge 12px on a 20px pill, in px so an app with a smaller root font keeps the phone reading size.

title: Focused shell mode and inbox reader building blocks
detail: useShellFocusMode() collapses DefaultAppShell and WorkspaceShell to a 56px icon rail and hides the header toggle, bell and header actions while a screen is mounted. Tabs take icon, detail and appearance "plain" (muted counts). StepList rows take sources and highlighted. The text Input primitive and AiTextField/AiTextArea take endAction, an icon button inside the right edge (e.g. a microphone), or with label a small primary text button (e.g. "Antworten"). StepList takes status (badge) and subtitle for the header. PdfPreview variant "viewer" takes matchIndex, onMatchesChange and hideSearchBar so a host can drive hit navigation from its own stepper. MobileTopBar is the phone-only (md:hidden) top bar for focused screens, with label, optional back chevron, status chip and actions, since the shell header is hidden there. StepList takes fill (full container height, footer pinned) and shows done steps with the ok token. progress "count" keeps only the "x of y done" count, "none" hides count and bar. MessageThread html bodies show a quiet "HTML mail, shown sanitized. External images blocked." line with a link-style "Load images" action, hide blocked images instead of a broken frame, and render sanitized tables without outer borders and with thin row dividers. A rejected StepList step uses a neutral grey disc with the secondary text tone for its X icon. PdfViewer search marks only the matched characters in amber (stronger for the active match) and matches phrases across text-layer lines, ignoring whitespace. The focus rail uses 40px rounded-md tiles with muted sidebar icons, 4px spacing and a 32px rounded-md brand tile. PdfPreview/PdfViewer take fill (no 480px floor, the host layout sizes the pane). MessageThread takes showHeaders false to drop author, address and time above open messages.

title: StepList collapseWhen "overflow", hidden Field label without gap, thread row chevron, PdfViewer scroll padding
detail: StepList gains collapseWhen ("always" by default, the old behaviour). With "overflow" a fill list with collapsedAfter shows every step while they fit its height and folds only when they do not, then shows as many steps as fit but at least collapsedAfter. A Field with hideLabel and no changed marker, appendix or status no longer renders an empty label row, so its control is not pushed down by the column gap and lines up with a button beside it. Collapsed earlier mails in MessageThread show a chevron, a hover background and a pointer cursor. PdfViewer keeps its padding above a page it jumps to (scroll-padding), so the page no longer touches the toolbar.

title: Inbox reader widgets (MessageThread, MessageReader, StepList, surfaces, PdfPreview viewer)
detail: New web widgets MessageThread and MessageReader (older messages fold to one line, quoted text behind a toggle, HTML bodies in a sandboxed script-free iframe with external images blocked until the reader asks, attachment chips and tabs), StepList (progress header, status icons, per-step actions, collapsedAfter), and the surfaces SenderFrame, SenderSheet and AiSurface backed by new theme tokens sender-frame, sender-frame-border, sender-sheet, ai-surface, radius-sheet and shadow-sheet. PdfPreview gains variant "viewer" (thumbnail rail, page jump, zoom, search with highlighted hits), searchTerm, initialPage and onPageChange; both variants now render pages lazily as they scroll into view. New i18n keys kumiko.widget.pdf-preview.*, message-thread.*, message-reader.* and step-list.* ship in de, es, fr and it.

title: InfinityList can end in content that scrolls with its rows
detail: New prop endContent renders after the last loaded row, inside the list's scroll container, for example a "not found what you were looking for?" hint right under search hits. It is not shown while the list shows its empty state; put such a hint into emptyState as well if it should appear there.

title: Thread folds older mails for a phone, step waiting reason as text on a phone
detail: `foldOlderTogether` on MessageThread shows one "2 frühere Mails anzeigen" toggle above the newest mail instead of a row per older message; a click lists them as rows. In such a folded thread the toggle under a clamped mail body reads "Ganze Mail lesen" (en "Read the whole mail"); every other thread keeps "Mehr anzeigen". There an html mail is cut to the same lines by height; html mails in other threads still show whole. A folded thread uses narrow phone padding (SenderSheet `compact`). In every html mail the first block no longer adds its top margin above the text. In a folded thread the last mail's attachments render as full-width `AttachmentCard`s below the thread frame instead of chips (`MessageAttachment.thumbnailUrl` is new). New widget `AttachmentCard` shows a thumbnail or kind icon, name, second line and a "Original ansehen" link or button. New theme tokens `search-hit`, `search-hit-active` and `source-mark` (`bg-search-hit`, `bg-search-hit-active`, `bg-source-mark`) color PDF search hits, the active hit and a host-marked source passage. Plain and filter tab strips use normal weight for inactive tabs. A StepList with `phoneCard` shows a locked step's "Wartet auf" reason as a plain 13px line below the md breakpoint and keeps the badge on desktop. A `StepTag` with `afterWaiting: true` (e.g. "Gerade geändert") renders after the waiting badge; other tags stay before it. The PDF text layer now applies pdf.js's per-span font size and horizontal fit itself, so search hits and source marks sit exactly on the word whatever the app's body font or root font size is. A hit or marked passage is drawn as one band per line (fused across table cells) instead of one chip per text span.

title: Tab strips tighten their spacing in narrow containers
detail: DefaultTabs is a size container now. Below a strip width of 32rem (512px) it uses px-2.5 and gap-2, so four counted tabs fit a 400px list pane. Strips 32rem and wider keep px-6 and gap-6, and a strip that grows after mount gets the wide spacing back. A strip that still overflows keeps the edge fade at the cut side.

title: Compact page header puts the status under the title
detail: At phone width the header status slot moves to its own small line below the page title instead of sharing the row with it, so the title no longer truncates while it fits alone. Secondary actions stay in the overflow menu as before.

title: PdfViewer shows the page top of a search hit
detail: Stepping to a search hit used to center the hit, which left an empty frame above short pages. The viewer now brings the hit's page top into view and scrolls further only when the hit sits below the fold. The zoom label in the toolbar keeps "100 %" on one line at smaller root font sizes.

title: PdfPreview shows only the pages with pagesOnly
detail: PdfPreview and PdfViewer take pagesOnly. The viewer then drops its thumbnail rail and toolbar and keeps the pages on the sand frame, for hosts that step through search hits with their own controls, such as a search result that opens a document on its hit. searchTerm and matchIndex work as with hideSearchBar.

title: PdfPreview marks a source passage with markTerm and keeps its search usable
detail: PdfPreview and PdfViewer take markTerm, for a passage such as the clause a step was read from. The viewer marks it on the page it opens on, keeps the page top in view instead of centering a search hit, and leaves its search toggle in the toolbar; a term typed into the search replaces the mark while it is set. The zoom and search buttons of the toolbar are now 28px bordered buttons. StatusBadge is 20px high instead of 22px, and a StepList tag that is too long for its column is cut with the full text as tooltip.

title: StatusBadge dot no longer squashes in a narrow badge
detail: A long badge text inside a width-limited container shrank the leading dot to a thin line. The dot now keeps its size and only the text is cut.

title: Step links can sit under the step text
detail: `StepListItem.link.placement: "below"` renders the link as a link button under the step's description and meta, for an action that changes the step such as taking a rejection back; the default stays the trailing link to what the step made, now underlined. The header title takes the free width, so a status badge without progress sits at the right edge, and the subtitle uses the secondary text tone.

title: The "more steps" row of a collapsed StepList reads as a note
detail: The row that reveals hidden steps is now 13px secondary text with 12px/16px padding and no bottom rule, like the inbox design. It still expands the list on click.

title: StepList phone card, quieter mobile top bar
detail: `phoneCard` on StepList keeps the desktop panel and, below the md breakpoint, puts the header inside the rounded surface and the steps in a framed white box with tighter rows; the progress bar is left out there. MobileTopBar uses the card background instead of the page background, a 13px label and a 4px gap, like the phone reader design.

title: Step sources and tags share one line
detail: A step's source links (now underlined) and its tags, including "Waiting for", wrap together in one 13px row instead of two stacked rows. The StepList section sets the 14px body size, so step titles no longer inherit a larger host size.

title: successLinks take params read from the success payload
detail: ActionFormSuccessLink gets params, a map from URL search param to success-payload field. `{ screen: "cockpit", params: { cmd: "duplicateOfId" } }` opens the cockpit with `?cmd=<duplicateOfId>`. The link stays hidden while a mapped field is not a string, like a link whose id field is missing.

title: Tabs have a filter appearance for the filter strip of a list pane
detail: DefaultTabs takes appearance "filter" next to "pill" and "plain". It keeps the plain look (muted count, 40px strip) and insets the strip by 6px with no gap between tabs, so the first label lines up with a list pane's search field. "plain" now sits flush with its content with a 4px gap. Both pad each tab by 10px on either side and space icon, label and count by 6px; before, the count stood 12px after its label. "pill" is unchanged.

title: toggleSetMember helper
detail: toggleSetMember(set, value) from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer returns a new Set with value removed if it was present and added if it was not. The input set is not changed, so it fits React state updaters for expanded or collapsed ids.

title: SSE client reconnects after a stalled stream
detail: createEventSourceLiveEvents arms a 30 s watchdog (two missed server heartbeats) that is reset by open, ping and every entity or session-ended frame. On expiry it closes the connection and reconnects through the existing backoff path, which resyncs all listeners. The timer is cleared on close and error. The seam is the new stallTimers option.

title: Lists and dashboard stats take named filters
detail: entityList and projectionList take namedFilters [{ id, label }], shown as a removable chip and kept in the URL as <screenId>.filter; it reaches the list, facet and count queries, and defaultFilters are skipped while it is active. A dashboard stat takes navigate { screen, namedFilter } and becomes a link to the filtered list. The boot validator checks that ids exist, that a projectionList query accepts namedFilter, and that the tile counts with the target list's own query and namedFilter.

title: The editor panel keeps its save bar pinned
detail: A FormScreenLayout editor inside the editor panel gets the full panel height, so its save bar stays visible while the content scrolls.

title: projectionDetail metrics can be formatted
detail: `metrics[].format` takes a `FormatSpec` such as `{ format: "date" }`. The metric shows the formatted value (an empty result falls back to the raw text); the tone still resolves on the raw value. Without `format` nothing changes.

title: Dashboard list panels show the target's label for reference columns
detail: A reference column in a dashboard list panel showed the stored id. It now resolves the target record's label and links to it, using the same lookup as entity lists.

title: Notification bell in the shell header
detail: With the channel-in-app feature in the schema and a signed-in user, ShellHeader renders a bell with an unread badge (99+ from 100) and a popover list with title, body, relative time, mark all read and load more. A click marks the entry read and opens its target screen when the schema has it. The delivered signal refetches the count and the open list; there is no polling. SSE frames without an aggregateType now reach subscribers keyed by the frame name. New keys `kumiko.notifications.*` in the default bundle and in all four locale packages.

title: Tab description is rendered on groups tabs
detail: The `description` of a section with tabbed groups was dropped; only fields and relatedList tabs showed it. The outer card of a groups tab now renders it as its subtitle, also when a relatedList tab has no rows.

title: Searchable reference facets
detail: A reference facet in entityList, projectionList and relatedList loads a page of options and a search field narrows them on the server (300 ms debounce), so values beyond the first page can be filtered by. Chosen values keep their label from a separate by-id request, also after a reload from the URL. A reference field with `optionsQuery` uses that handler for the facet. The 200-row warning is gone; `DataTableFacet` gets optional `onSearchChange` and `searching`.

title: Reference labels resolve by id beyond the lookup caps
detail: ReadOnlyReferenceValue, the reference combobox and embedded-list reference cells request the stored ids next to their first options page; list reference columns request the ids on screen in chunks of 200 instead of the first 200 rows of the target. The ids go out as `ids` for directory sources and an id-in filter for entity list handlers, which only narrow the caller's list query, so tenant, ownership and field-read rules keep applying. Author `optionsQuery` handlers on reference fields keep their capped `{ limit, search? }` picker page and are additionally asked for stored values with `{ limit, ids }`; a handler that ignores `ids` keeps the previous capped behaviour. List columns keep labels already known while the ids of a new page load and only claim "Unknown" once the current ids have resolved.

title: Server field errors without a field on the form show in the form banner
detail: An entityEdit save that fails with a field error whose path is not a rendered field (for example a field an extension section writes) now shows the message in the form error banner instead of losing it.

title: A live refresh that a load-more supersedes is retried instead of lost
detail: When a live signal triggered a first-page refresh while the list loaded its next page, the refresh result was discarded and nothing re-ran it, so the change on page 1 stayed invisible until the next event. The discarded refresh now runs once more.

title: edit screens opened without a record use screen:<id>.createTitle
detail: When a detail screen is opened without an entity id and the feature translates `screen:<id>.createTitle`, the breadcrumb and page title use it instead of the edit title. managed-pages names its create state "New page".

title: resizable tables size columns by content until the user resizes one
detail: With `table.resizing` on (also through `bundledLists`), columns without a schema `width` no longer start at a flat 160px. The table keeps the auto layout and sizes them by content until the user drags or arrow-keys a column; that first resize stores the displayed widths of the other columns too, so nothing jumps. The first column of a resizable table breaks only when the table runs out of width, and a clickable first cell wraps instead of truncating, and dates and timestamps (also through a `format` renderer) stay on one line. `onWidthChange` gets an optional third argument with those widths. Stored widths from earlier sessions still apply; a browser that saved any view setting before this release still holds the old 160px widths until the view is reset. Apps with `bundledLists.table.resizing` (use-all-bundled, solon) see wider name columns and narrower leftover space on first visit.

title: Floating panel keeps its distance to the window edge
detail: Moving, resizing and window resizes clamp the panel 16px inside the viewport instead of at the border. On a window resize the panel keeps its gap to the nearer horizontal and vertical edge, so a bottom-right panel no longer sticks to the right border when the window narrows. Stored geometry stays valid and is only clamped again.

title: One copy of Radix dismissable layers
detail: Dialog, Popover, DropdownMenu and Toast now come from the radix-ui package instead of the single @radix-ui/react-* packages, which dropped nine direct dependencies. A root override pins @radix-ui/react-dialog to 1.3.1 because cmdk would otherwise pull an older dialog with its own react-dismissable-layer. Apps that import @radix-ui/react-* themselves, or add cmdk, should align their own lockfile to one react-dialog version.

title: A projectionDetail can be a dashboard screen panel
detail: A `screen` panel or its `fallback` may point at a projectionDetail. The id comes from the host dashboard's `record` binding and is passed to the embedded screen as its entityId. Boot fails when the host dashboard has no `record`. Header, fields and Detail query render inline in the tile.

title: Toolbar actions accept visibleWhen
detail: Every toolbar action of a projectionList or entityList takes an optional `visibleWhen` ({ query, field, eq }). The button shows only while the live query matches; it stays hidden while the query loads and when it fails. Buttons gating on the same query share one request. Boot checks the query, its output field and that it needs no input. relatedList toolbar actions reject `visibleWhen`.
