title: Screen fallback can depend on the failure reason
detail: A screen-level `fallback` is either a screen id (unchanged) or a map `{ hidden, forbidden, notFound, error }`. `forbidden` is a 403 and `notFound` a 404 on the gate query; `hidden` is an unmet condition; `error` is any other failure. A reason without an entry shows a default notice (new keys kumiko.screen.forbidden and kumiko.screen.notFound) and `error` shows an error banner with retry. Boot rejects an empty map and checks each entry like a string fallback.

title: List descriptions sit beside the toolbar actions
detail: A description plus a toolbar with only end content (no search, no facets) renders as one row with the actions on the right, in embedded and full-height lists. Before, a full-height list put the description under the create button. With search or facets the layout is unchanged. Section header actions wrap below the title on narrow widths.

title: The projectionDetail header badge shows the translated status
detail: The header badge formats its text with header.statusFormat. Without it, the badge reuses the layout renderer of the status field when that is enumOption or i18nText, so header and body show the same text. Without either, the raw value is shown as before. The tone keeps resolving on the raw value.

title: The shell header title follows the active workspace
detail: When two navs point at the same screen, the breadcrumb now takes the label of the nav the sidebar shows for the active workspace. Before, the first nav in the app won, so the title could differ from the sidebar entry. Without a matching nav in the workspace, the old lookup applies.

title: The detail header keeps inlineActions as buttons
detail: HeaderActionsBar takes inlineActionIds and renders those actions as buttons after the primary action; only the remaining actions go into the overflow menu, and no menu is shown when none remain.

title: The relatedList empty state follows the parent record
detail: RelatedListSection evaluates emptyState.variants against the parent record and shows the first matching text. The headless view model translates the variant texts.

title: English header comments in the renderer e2e config
detail: Comment-only change in the renderer Playwright config and the demo dev bootstrap; no runtime behavior changes.

title: A drawer-hosted actionForm follows its redirect
detail: After a successful submit the drawer closes, the host refetches, and a declared redirect then navigates like on the full page, without returnTo. A redirect that points at the screen the drawer sits on (no record id, no tab) does not navigate, so filters and scroll position stay. Behavior change: before, a drawer ignored redirect.

title: Live queries follow the handler's liveEntities
detail: useQuery({ live: true }) and InfinityList refetch on signals for the entity in the query name and for every entity the query handler declares in liveEntities, in both the declared and the kebab-case form. The app schema carries them per feature as queryLiveEntities, and a tenant feature toggle strips them with the feature. A query that reads a second entity no longer needs a name under that entity to stay live.

title: Translated text cells, toned status pills, screen links in rows and live detail screens
detail: An i18nText cell renders the text in the user's language. An enumOption column with tones draws the translated label as a status pill. A column with linkScreenField links the cell to the screen the row names, but only when the user may open that screen. A projectionDetail with live: true refetches the record and its relatedList sections on entity events. With metricsStyle "tiles" its metrics render as the dashboard KPI tiles (StatCard), the icon chip colored by the metric's tone; like on dashboards a value of 0 keeps the neutral tone.

title: No repeated screen title on detail screens, header actions as high as the header controls, embedded table description first
detail: A projectionDetail without a record title no longer repeats the screen title above its sections when the shell header already shows it. Screen actions in the shell header are now as high as the header's own controls (h-8) instead of the toolbar height. An embedded table (one that does not fill the screen height) shows its description above its toolbar, right under the section title.

title: actionForm optionsQuery selects seed the row marked default
detail: A row of an optionsQuery result can carry default: true. In an actionForm the first such row fills an empty field as a baseline value, like a prefill, so the form stays unchanged and leaving it asks nothing; set submitPrefilled to submit the suggestion unchanged. When a sibling field changes the payload and the old value drops out of the new rows, the new default replaces it as a normal change. configEdit never pre-selects, and a set value is never replaced.

title: previewOpenByDefault opens the newest file
detail: FileValueList with previewOpenByDefault (renderer format "file") now opens only the PDF preview of the newest file instead of the first one. Uploads append their FileRef id, so the newest file is the last id in fileIds.

title: DataTable card title is truncated instead of wrapping
detail: In the mobile card layout a long title now truncates to one line with its full text on hover, and the row-actions menu no longer shrinks or leaves the viewport next to it. Before, the title wrapped over several lines and could squeeze the menu.

title: DataTable resizing: row click in the leftover width, grip named by title
detail: With column sizing the actions column absorbs the leftover width, and its cell swallowed every click, so a click on the free area to the right of the last column did not open the row. Only clicks from inside the cell (buttons, menus) stop now; a click on the empty cell reaches the row. The resize grips carry their text as title instead of aria-label, so getByLabel on a column name no longer matches the grip of every column. The accessible name stays, getByRole("separator", { name }) keeps working.

title: One tiptap range across the framework packages
detail: bundled-features pinned @tiptap/* exactly to 3.31.3 while the renderer asked for ^3.30.5. Apps resolved the renderer's range to a newer patch and kept the exact pin next to it, so their lockfiles held two @tiptap/core and @tiptap/react instances (core 3.31.3 and 3.31.4 in offlot-app, money-horse, publicstatus, phronexsis, show-pony and kumiko-enterprise). Both packages now declare ^3.31.3 for every @tiptap/* dependency, so one resolved version satisfies both; the framework lockfile still resolves 3.31.3.

title: Table-driven field and input dispatch
detail: DefaultInput, renderInput, RenderField and the read-only field text dispatch over tables, and ReferenceInput keeps its query and create state in one hook. Rendered markup and behavior are unchanged.

title: Split list and detail screens into hooks and render functions
detail: RenderList, ProjectionListBody and ProjectionDetailBody compose focused hooks and render functions for search, columns, toolbar, queries, actions, header and states. Rendered markup and behavior are unchanged.

title: Split RenderEdit into hooks and per-kind section renderers
detail: RenderEdit composes focused hooks and builders for state, form, draft, wizard navigation and submit, and renders sections through per-kind functions. Rendered markup and behavior are unchanged.

title: Split web StackedAreaChart into hooks and render functions
detail: StackedAreaChart composes window and tooltip hooks with geometry builders and render functions for the plot, tooltip, brush and chrome. Rendered markup and behavior are unchanged.

title: Split web dashboard, form footer, drawer and data table into hooks and render functions
detail: WebDashboardBody, FormFooter, Drawer and DefaultDataTable compose focused hooks and render functions for screen state, header, visibility gates, panel tiles, sticky footer rows, drawer resizing, table state, toolbar, table rows and card views. Rendered markup and behavior are unchanged.

title: DataTable view menu, remembered list state and compact density
detail: Lists with a table block show a view menu (columns, density, reset view) and a reset-all button. Remembered query parameters are copied into the URL once; links with explicit parameters win. Compact density uses 32px rows with 4px cell padding. New keys kumiko.list.reset-all and kumiko.list.view.* in all locale packages.

title: remembered column pins and widths in the list view state
detail: useListTable passes pins, widths, minWidths and keyboardNavigation to the DataTable view options. Pins and widths live in the list-state store next to columns and density; a saved pin set replaces the schema pins, so a user can release a pinned column. New keys kumiko.list.view.pinning, kumiko.list.view.pin-left, kumiko.list.view.pin-right and kumiko.list.column.resize in all locale packages.

title: DataTable resize grip, pinned focus ring and bounded widths
detail: Column widths stay between minWidth and 2000 px, also when read back from the session. The resize grip shows on header hover and focus and carries aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax. Pinned and actions cells repeat the keyboard focus ring, and a pressed pin button is highlighted.

title: Server-side groups, totals row and number range facet in the DataTable
detail: With table.grouping the groups load via one aggregate query; each open group near the viewport loads its rows with the list query plus a group filter, page by page with "Load more", at most four groups at once, a collapsed group sends no query. Headers show the server count and measures, the global pager gives way in both pagination modes, and the view menu offers "Group by" with userChoice. table.totals renders a live footer row over the filters and search. A range facet shows from/to inputs, keeps <screenId>.f.<field>.min/.max in the URL and sends gte/lte filters, money in minor units. Infinite lists now also start over when a facet changes. New keys kumiko.list.group.*, kumiko.list.measure.*, kumiko.list.totals.label, kumiko.list.range.* and kumiko.list.notice.* in all locale packages.

title: DataTable row selection and bulk run
detail: With bulkActions the table gets a checkbox column, a header checkbox for the loaded rows (at most 100), a checkbox per card and a bar with "n selected" and the actions. A run sends one /api/write per row, at most 4 at a time; rows hidden by the row action's visible are skipped. Cancel stops new writes. A banner shows succeeded, failed, skipped and not run; failed and not-run rows stay selected and the list reloads. With table.keyboardNavigation, Space toggles the focused row. New keys kumiko.list.bulk.* in all locale packages.

title: entityList writeHandler row actions keep display
detail: entityList built its writeHandler row actions inline and dropped display; it now uses the same builder as projection and related lists.

title: Export button in the DataTable toolbar
detail: Lists with table.export show an Export button next to the view menu. It exports the current search, sort and facets with the visible columns in their order and shows a hint when the list exceeds the row limit. New keys kumiko.list.export, kumiko.list.export-busy, kumiko.list.export-too-many and kumiko.list.export-failed in all locale packages.

title: All primary toolbar actions move into the list page header
detail: Previously at most one primary toolbar action was promoted, and only when the list had no create button. Now every primary action without a confirm dialog sits in the page header, left of the create button (which stays rightmost), in declaration order. Promoted actions no longer appear in the list toolbar. On phones they become entries of the header overflow menu when a create button is present, so the create button keeps its place.

title: renderer { format: "file", previewOpenByDefault: true } opens the first PDF preview
detail: FileValueList takes a previewOpenByDefault prop, set declaratively through the file renderer spec, so the inline preview of the first file starts open. The preview is only mounted for PDFs. Without the option the toggle behaves as before.

title: DataTable rowGrouping removed
detail: The client-side rowGrouping prop and the DataTableRowGrouping type are removed from the DataTable contract; grouping runs only through serverGroups. A custom DataTable primitive drops its rowGrouping handling.
migration: delete rowGrouping from custom DataTable primitives and their callers; group lists through table.grouping on the screen

title: Totals row keeps its leading cells pinned
detail: With pinned columns, the empty totals cells under the checkbox and expand columns stick to the left like the cells above them, and the cell under the actions column sticks to the right with the same background.

title: Success message resolves reference labels by id
detail: resolveSuccessMessageParams requests the chosen record by id, so a tenant picked in a tier-admin form with more than 200 tenants is named in the success message instead of showing its raw id. Sources that ignore both inputs keep the previous capped-list behaviour.

title: Locked fallback chains show the rendered screen in the header
detail: When a screen with visibleWhen falls back to another screen that is locked too, the page header and breadcrumb now name the screen that actually renders instead of the locked intermediate fallback.

title: Provider forms stay usable without secrets access
detail: The merged provider form (config keys plus secrets) previously showed only an error banner if the viewer was denied the secrets list. Now the secret fields are left out and host, port, sender and provider choice can still be saved.

title: PDF previews keep their document while mounted
detail: createBoundedLoadCache now returns { load, retain }. PdfPreview retains its document while mounted, and the cache evicts only unused entries, so a fifth document no longer destroys one that is still rendered.

title: Leave guard keeps the history clean on Back and Forward
detail: Confirming the leave dialog after a browser Back or Forward now uses history.back(), so the target is no longer duplicated in the history stack. Popstate events that arrive while a leave request is open restore the URL and leave the open dialog untouched.

title: basePath option for createKumikoApp and the auth pages
detail: createKumikoApp accepts basePath. The default auth pages gate matches its paths below the prefix, and the login screen builds its default forgot-password and unlock hrefs with it, so mail links to /admin/unlock-account no longer end on the login screen. New exports BasePathProvider, useBasePath, normalizeBasePath, stripBasePath and prependBasePath.

title: secrets-denied test fixture without a cast
detail: The fixture's field map already fits the annotated ConfigEditScreenDefinition, so the cast and its marker are gone. No runtime change.

title: List view model and cell formats as tables
detail: computeListViewModel resolves each column through an ordered list of resolvers and applyFormatSpec dispatches through a table of cell formatters. Output is unchanged; a format named like an Object.prototype member such as "toString" still takes the unknown-format path.

title: Single-line row actions, stable form columns and select width, system-scope configEdit
detail: Row actions never wrap onto a second line; the template overview lets long titles break and cuts the slug earlier so the table keeps room at 1280 px. In screen forms a section with explicitly declared columns (two or more) lays out as that many columns, and a select cell is as wide as a text cell instead of growing with its help text. A configEdit screen with scope system now reads the system level, so a SystemAdmin no longer sees the value of their own tenant row.

title: Uniform control height in page headers and list toolbars, spacing for projectionList descriptions
detail: Buttons in the page header (create, toolbarActions, detail actions, form actions and app-added buttons such as the AI button) and in list toolbars (search, filters, secondary actions) now share one height, independent of the size a screen or app requested. A toolbarAction promoted into the page header no longer renders smaller than the standard create button. A projectionList without a toolbar no longer glues its description to the page header. The header of a CollapsibleSection ("Erweitert") has the same height as the form controls next to it.

title: Input gets kind "code" and autoFocus on kind "text"
detail: Input has a new kind "code" (length, onComplete, autoFocus, autoComplete defaulting to one-time-code), a single real input shown as separate cells; onComplete fires once when input, paste or autofill reaches full length and the value holds digits only. kind "text" gains autoFocus.
migration: custom Input implementations (PrimitivesProvider override) with an exhaustive switch over props.kind need a case "code"; delegating to DefaultInput from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/web is enough

title: Renderer low-severity robustness fixes
detail: The list search echo handling no longer mutates state during render and no longer re-sends an already sent value. A failing live refetch no longer drops a queued follow-up run. Downloaded blob URLs are revoked after a delay, failed PDF loads are retried on the next mount, the file meta cache is cleared when the app gate unmounts, and renderFlow rejects duplicate node ids and unknown icons. The es/fr/it titles of the reset-to-system action now say the tenant template is reset to the system template.

title: Renderer review fixes for lookups, dropzone, markSaved, actionForm reset and dashboard gates
detail: Reference labels show "Unknown" only when the lookup page was complete; a related-list column keeps sortable on fields without a sortable key; a files dropzone lists and can remove files already in the value; extension markSaved accepts the written field names, no longer clears other sections' dirty state; an actionForm with load and resetOnSuccess reloads the record before resetting; fallback panels no longer flash before the visibility gate answers; identical text blocks get unique keys; the missing-screen warning names the route id.

title: useTenantCurrency hook
detail: The tenant currency resolution of the entity edit prefill is exported as a hook with an explicit fallback for errors and missing values and no query when no currency is needed; the mail preview uses it only for templates with a money variable.

title: ChoiceCards widget and PlanCard price prefix
detail: ChoiceCards is a card-styled radio group (title, description, aside, native radios, keyboard operable) for exclusive choices that need more than a segment label. PlanCardPrice takes an optional prefix shown before the amount, for example "from".

title: View-model inputs take only the entity parts they read
detail: ComputeEditViewModelInput.entity and ComputeListViewModelInput.entity are typed as the Pick of EntityDefinition they actually read, so synthesized entities need no cast. Passing a full EntityDefinition keeps working. Renderer console output goes through one dev-console module.

title: A section with a visible action is not hidden when all its fields are
detail: Edit and detail sections (entityEdit, projectionDetail, in every app) whose fields are all hidden by visibility conditions now stay on screen while at least one of their actions is visible. Before, such a section vanished together with its action buttons; apps that relied on that to hide a section must hide the action with its own visible condition.

title: Fraction digits for number and decimal formats
detail: { format: "number" | "decimal", maximumFractionDigits: 4 } renders 0.0004 as 0.0004 (de: 0,0004) instead of 0; minimumFractionDigits pads. Integers 0 to 20 with min not above max; anything else is ignored and the Intl default (3 digits) applies, so existing formats render unchanged.

title: DayPicker and QR code load on demand
detail: The calendar popover and the QR secret value import react-day-picker and qrcode lazily, so screens without a date input or an MFA setup no longer ship them. Date popovers render their grid one tick later; tests should use findBy queries.

title: projectionDetail metrics render their own label
detail: The metrics band reads the label from each metric entry instead of falling back to `fieldLabels` or the column name.

title: Error reference with copy button in toasts, banners and fallbacks
detail: A server error that carries a request id now shows "Error ID: <id>" with a copy button in toasts, action error banners, the write-form error section, query error banners and list empty states. The root and screen error fallbacks show a per-error id the same way; the root fallback is styled with inline styles so it stays readable without CSS. New exports ErrorReference, ErrorNotice and errorNoticeOf; New keys kumiko.error.reference, kumiko.error.copyReference and kumiko.error.referenceCopied in all locale packages.

title: HeaderActionsBar onError receives an ErrorNotice instead of a string
detail: The onError prop of HeaderActionsBar is now (notice: ErrorNotice | null) => void, where ErrorNotice is { message, requestId? }, so the error reference can be shown next to the message.
migration: change the handler to read notice.message (and notice.requestId); a handler that stores the string only needs `notice?.message ?? null`

title: createKumikoApp reports browser errors to POST /api/client-errors
detail: New option reportClientErrors (default true) sends error-boundary errors (kind render) and window error and unhandledrejection events (kind unhandled) to /api/client-errors with the same errorId the fallback shows, at most 5 reports per page load, identical messages once, path without query and hash, CSRF header when a token is present. A custom onError runs in addition and receives { errorId, screen? } as third argument. Set reportClientErrors: false to opt out.

title: Global navigation with search params asks before dropping unsaved input
detail: navigateWithReturnTo, navigateToReturn, the metric tab navigation, closing the editor panel and the target resolver now go through the leave guard, and a requestLeave nested in a confirmed leave no longer asks twice. List filters and sorting stay unguarded because they do not unmount a form. The mail designer registers its draft as unsaved input, so link and browser navigation ask before discarding it.

title: ExtensionSectionProps.markSaved marks host form values as saved
detail: ExtensionSectionProps gains an optional markSaved callback, set in entityEdit sections and the entityEdit footer slot. An extension section that writes the host entity's values through its own command calls it after the write succeeds; the host form then counts as clean and a following navigation passes the leave guard without the discard dialog. Additive API.
migration: None. Additive API.

title: actionForm success box shows the message and every fact on its own line
detail: The success message and the successFacts of an actionForm no longer run together ("Fertig.Gebucht: 20Übersprungen: 0"). The message is its own line, a fact with one value is one "Label: value" line, a fact with several lines (for example file names) is a label line followed by one line per value instead of a comma chain. New test ids action-form-success-text and action-form-success-fact-<n>-line-<i>.
migration: None. Tests that read the textContent of a multi-line fact now see the label and the lines without the former ", " separators.

title: Empty list with an active default filter offers "Show all"
detail: A list that is empty only because its defaultFilters are on says so and offers a Show all button instead of the "create the first one" text. The hard-coded Loading… banners use the kumiko.widget.loading key, so they follow the locale.

title: Count messages use singular and plural forms
detail: Nine count messages (template usage, mail preview entries, layout origin and footer, tag delete confirmation, embedded-list paste warnings) now come as .one and .other keys in en, de, es, fr and it, so "1 template" no longer reads "1 templates". Apps that override these keys must rename them to .one and .other.

title: Shell header: the parent crumb no longer slides under a long title
detail: The page title truncates on its own; the parent crumb stays whole and is left out when the space beside the header actions gets narrower than 20rem (a container query on the header's left side instead of the sm viewport breakpoint). The h1 carries the full title as tooltip.

title: A rejected empty embedded list shows its error at the list, once, without a banner-only failure
detail: The empty state of an embedded list now shows list-level issues (min items, required), and the surrounding field no longer prints them a second time. An issue on a derived head total that is not laid out (an empty list leaves it without a value) no longer adds the generic form banner while another issue is shown; it still shows the banner when it is the only issue. A list below its minItems now reads "At least 1 row required." / "At least N rows required." (errors.validation.list_min_rows.one and .other) instead of the generic too-small text. Only embedded lists get the row wording (their schema reports a custom issue with params.i18nKey and minimum, which both zod bridges now forward); other arrays such as a required multiSelect keep errors.validation.too_small.
migration: None.

title: An embedded list does not repeat its section title as a visible label
detail: When the label of an embedded-list field equals the title of the section it sits in (for example "Positionen" under "Positionen"), entityEdit and actionForm screens now keep the label for screen readers only instead of printing it twice. Applies by default, no setting.
migration: None.

title: Embedded-list footer totals can sum several columns under their own label
detail: EmbeddedFieldDef.totals entries are now a column name (as before) or { label, from } with an i18n label and the sub-fields to add up, for example Net { from: ["amount"] }, VAT { from: ["vatAmount"] } and Gross { from: ["amount", "vatAmount"] }. Display only, the server derivation is unchanged. The boot validator rejects an empty from and any from entry that is not a number, money or decimal sub-field. Money sums use the same format as string totals. The ui-walkthrough receive-invoice screen and the embedded recipe now lay out only the Positionen list with a footer of Net, VAT and Gross; the derived head totals are still computed on the server but not laid out, and the list requires at least one line (minItems 1).
migration: Optional. Replace a totals string list with labelled entries where the footer should show Net, VAT and Gross (solon invoice screens).

title: projectionDetail shows the record again after a record action
detail: After a writeHandler action on a projectionDetail (header or section action) the screen refetched the record but the shown fields kept their old values until a reload. The actions now reload through the same path as the reload button, which re-applies the refetched record to a form without user input.
migration: None.

title: Live updates reconnect, resync and coalesce refetches
detail: The web EventSource reconnects with exponential backoff and jitter after a refused handshake unless the session ended, rewires every subscribed entity on the new connection and sends each listener a LIVE_RESYNC_EVENT_TYPE event after a reconnect, because frames during the gap are lost. useQuery and the nav tree refetch in the background and collapse a burst of live events into one trailing run (LIVE_REFETCH_COALESCE_MS); an event during a running fetch queues exactly one follow-up. A failed refetch keeps the last data on screen and shows QueryErrorBanner with a retry button above it.

title: Forms ask before unsaved input is discarded
detail: A dirty entity form or writeForm section now asks with the discard dialog before an in-app navigation, a projectionDetail tab switch, browser back or forward, and the browser asks on tab close or reload (beforeunload). A successful save clears the form before its follow-up navigation, and wizards with layout.draft keep their draft instead of asking. requestLeave, hasUnsavedInput and useUnsavedInputSource are exported for custom screens.
migration: End-to-end tests that fill a form and then navigate away without saving now meet the dialog (testId leave-guard-dialog); confirm it or save first. page.goto from a dirty form triggers the browser's beforeunload prompt.

title: Form writes carry a requestId and reuse it only for a safe retry
detail: The form controller passes { requestId } as third argument to dispatcher.write. After a transport failure without a server answer, a submit with the same values reuses the requestId, so the server idempotency guard does not run the write twice; any server answer or changed values get a new one. generateRequestId moved to the headless dispatcher module.
migration: Tests that assert a mocked dispatcher.write with toHaveBeenCalledWith(type, payload) must accept the third argument, e.g. toHaveBeenCalledWith(type, payload, expect.objectContaining({ requestId: expect.any(String) })). Custom Dispatcher implementations should forward options.requestId.

title: Failed submits focus the first invalid field, clearer format errors
detail: After a failed submit the web form focuses and scrolls to the first field with aria-invalid (FormProps.focusFirstErrorKey; native forms ignore it). Format errors for email, url, date, datetime and uuid name the expected format with an example, the error line no longer shifts the labels of neighbouring fields, and SegmentedControl options with up to four entries get equal widths.

title: Toolbar navigate actions are hidden when the user may not open the target screen
detail: A toolbarAction of kind navigate on entityList, projectionList and relatedList now follows the access rule of its target screen, the same check metric jumps use. Before, the button showed for every role and led to an access-denied page.
migration: None. Gate the target screen with its own access rule; the toolbar button follows it.

title: actionForm loads a singleton row without a record id
detail: load.singleton: true on an actionForm sends the load query without idParam and prefills the form from the tenant's single row, like projectionDetail. A route id is never forwarded. The boot validator rejects singleton together with idParam.

title: Dashboard text block link shown only to given roles
detail: A text block of kind link ({ text, screen, roles? }) renders a link to a screen and is hidden unless the user holds one of the roles. This only gates the display; the target screen still checks access on the server. The boot validator rejects an unknown target screen and an empty roles list.

title: DataTable no longer hides its last column under the sticky actions column
detail: Header and text cells wrap instead of staying on one line (badges, dates and row actions keep their own nowrap), and a row-action group wraps when the column is narrow. A table whose cells could not shrink scrolled sideways without a visible scrollbar and its last column slid under the sticky actions column. Long values now wrap (up to max-w-xs per column) instead of being cut with an ellipsis.

title: Non-modal drawers narrow the content instead of covering it
detail: A Drawer with modal={false} on a wide viewport now publishes the width it occupies as --kumiko-drawer-inset-right or --kumiko-drawer-inset-left on the document root, and the shell content area (main next to the sidebar) takes it as inline padding, so error banners, right columns and the pinned form footer end beside the drawer. Modal drawers and narrow viewports keep overlaying. Two non-modal drawers open on the same side overwrite each other's value.

title: Files fields show download and PDF preview
detail: A read-only detail field with renderer { format: "file" } (projectionDetail, readOnly edit field) lists each file with its name and a download link; PDFs get an inline preview toggle. New optional primitive FileValueList, and PdfPreview (moved here from the document designer) with a per-source bounded document cache so several PDFs can share a page. i18n keys kumiko.field.file-list.download/preview/hidePreview and kumiko.widget.pdf-preview.* ship in de, es, fr and it.
migration: PdfPreview is now exported from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/web (props: source {base64}|{url}, testId).

title: FormScreenLayout gives custom screens the standard form screen layout
detail: New universal component FormScreenLayout (children, description, actions, secondaryActions, onSubmit, width, testId) renders the same left-aligned form column, section stack and pinned footer as an entityEdit screen. Fill it with Section primitives (title, icon, subtitle); description becomes the form subtitle.
migration: Custom form screens can replace FormScreenShell + Card with FormScreenLayout + Section.

title: Card renders no footer bar for an empty footer slot
detail: slots.footer set to false or null (for example `hasDone && <Button/>`) left an empty grey footer bar. The bar now renders only when the footer slot has content.

title: flow-diagram subpath
detail: "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/flow-diagram" exports renderFlow(spec) and the FlowSpec, FlowNode, FlowEdge, FlowIcon types, a pure string function that renders an animated SVG flow diagram.

title: Renderer stylesheet no longer scans the document designer
detail: The renderer stylesheet stopped scanning the document designer sources by relative path, which broke in isolated installs.
migration: Apps that embed the document designer add `@import "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-document-designer/web/styles.css";` after the renderer stylesheet import in their styles.css.

title: PlanCard ctaLink
detail: PlanCard takes ctaLink ({ label, href, target? }) and renders it as a full-width link button in the footer instead of the cta button. The PlanCardLinkSlot type is exported from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/web next to PlanCardActionSlot.

title: The entityEdit discard-confirm test waits for the form's mount effects before it types and clicks
detail: The test rendered outside act and only waited for the input to appear. Under CPU load the form's mount effects (store subscription, dirty reporting) ran after the click, so the header action still had no discard confirm and the test failed. The render now runs inside act, so the detail query, the commit and the effects settle first. Test-only change, no runtime behavior changes.

title: headless and the live dispatcher moved into renderer
detail: The headless UI logic is exported from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/headless (with /headless/apex, /headless/dispatcher and /headless/locale-routing), the HTTP dispatcher from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/live. @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless and @cosmicdrift/kumiko-dispatcher-live now only re-export these subpaths and are removed after the consumer pass of wave 4.
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply, or bun kumiko codemod package-merge . --write. It rewrites imports of @cosmicdrift/kumiko-headless (and its subpaths) to @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/headless and imports of @cosmicdrift/kumiko-dispatcher-live to @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/live, and replaces both dependencies in package.json with kumiko-renderer.

title: renderer-web moved into renderer
detail: The web bindings are exported from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/web, the stylesheet from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/web/styles.css and the Tailwind theme plugin from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/web/theme-plugin. @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-web now only re-exports these and is removed after the consumer pass of wave 4.
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply, or bun kumiko codemod package-merge . --write. It rewrites imports and CSS @import lines of @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer-web (including /styles.css and /theme-plugin) to @cosmicdrift/kumiko-renderer/web and replaces the dependency in package.json with kumiko-renderer.

title: actionForm shows key figures from the handler's success payload
detail: ActionFormScreenDefinition gets successFacts, a list of { field, label } entries read from the success payload and shown in the success box next to successLinks while the screen stays put. A number or string is one value, an array a comma-separated list of numbers, strings or { label } objects, a missing field is hidden. Mutually exclusive with redirect (boot validator). Default behaviour is unchanged.

title: A text field with format month renders a native month input
detail: createTextField({ format: "month" }) renders <input type="month"> and carries YYYY-MM. The schema builder validates the pattern server-side (an empty string is accepted for optional fields). New InputProps kind "month" for custom Input primitives.
migration: Only custom CorePrimitives.Input implementations with an exhaustive switch over kind need a "month" branch; a text fallback is fine.

title: Array reference fields render as links in lists
detail: A reference column over an array field renders one link per entry, labelled from the eagerloaded record or the label lookup, like single references. New CellLinkItem and RuntimeCellLinkItems exports from the headless view model; DataTableCell accepts linkItems.

title: List empty state, sidebar rail cursor, toolbar description spacing and root form errors
detail: The empty list no longer shows a second Create button when Create is already in the page header. The sidebar rail edge, which only toggles open and closed, shows a pointer cursor instead of a resize cursor. toolbarDescription always gets the standard bottom spacing, not only with fillsHeight. A server error without a field reference (path "(root)") shows once in the form banner instead of also at a field.

title: Success box with links, form reset and field placeholder
detail: The actionForm success box shows the default text "Done." (kumiko.actionForm.success) next to successMessage links, resetOnSuccess remounts the form with its initial values, and EditFieldSpec.placeholder reaches text, number and textarea inputs.

title: Client action registry for row actions
detail: ClientActionsProvider, ActionNoticeProvider and runClientAction execute clientAction row actions on list, related list and record actions, with confirm, toast feedback and refetch.

title: actionForm load states and drawer row click
detail: An actionForm with load queries by the route, drawer or URL id and shows loading, error, not-found and missing-id states; loaded values count as prefill for submitPrefilled. A row click fires a rowClick drawer action in entityList, projectionList and relatedList.

title: Input prefix, suffix and fill button
detail: Text and number inputs show prefix and suffix text, and a fillAction renders a button that fetches a suggestion into the field, also for a readOnly field. The Input primitive takes prefix, suffix and fill; renderer-web draws them beside the input.

title: Empty values use one placeholder everywhere
detail: Empty table cells, reference columns, read-only fields and dashboard lists now share one em dash placeholder (exported as EMPTY_VALUE_PLACEHOLDER from the headless package) instead of mixing en and em dashes.

title: Form errors clear once the user edits the affected field
detail: In RenderEdit, typing into a field removes that field's server issues and the form-level issues, and dismisses the submit error banner. A version_conflict banner and a delete rejection stay until reloaded or retried. Programmatic value changes (initial, draft restore, action patches) leave errors untouched.

title: Reference fields and columns link to the referenced record
detail: A resolved reference in a list column or a read-only field links to the detail screen of the referenced entity when the user may open it, so the link also works in a new tab. Unresolved ids, system labels, multi-reference list cells and cells in a clickable first column or card stay plain text. New useOptionalNav hook returns undefined without a NavProvider.

title: Missing-screen page spaces title and hint like other cards
detail: The page-not-available card renders title and hint through the Card title and subtitle slots.

title: A screen that falls back via visibleWhen shows the fallback's title
detail: When visibleWhen locks a screen and its fallback renders instead, the header no longer stays empty. It shows the title of the fallback screen (resolved like any other screen title, from its nav label), never the locked screen's. A fallback without a title still leaves the header empty. PageHeader takes a new breadcrumbScreenId prop for this.

title: projectionDetail no longer shows an empty type-title block above the record
detail: The projectionDetail shim dropped recordTitleField, so the duplicate-title fix never applied to real projectionDetail screens. The synthesized edit screen now carries it, and the page header shows the record title once.

title: A route to a screen missing from the schema shows an empty state
detail: A tenant-disabled feature, stale link or typo no longer falls back to the first feature or shows "Screen not found: <qn>". The app renders "This page is not available" with a button to the landing screen; the qualified name only goes to the console. New i18n keys kumiko.screen-missing.title, .hint and .home (en, de, es). The access-denied banner of KumikoScreen and the toolbar drawer is now translated too (kumiko.screen-access-denied.title) and no longer prints the qualified name.
migration: e2e checks on the text "Screen not found" should use the testId kumiko-screen-not-found; the testIds are unchanged.

title: projectionDetail drops the duplicate title block
detail: A screen with recordTitleField no longer repeats the screen title above the form when the page header already shows the record title.

title: List search keeps the newest typed text; file lists tolerate duplicate ids; date ranges and locked selects validate correctly
detail: A late echo of an older debounced search emit no longer overwrites newer typing. Duplicate file ids no longer collide as React keys. An inverted date range is swapped only when both bounds parse. Select rules on writeExcluded or readOnly fields are now checked by the form schema.

title: A failed refetch of a visibleWhen gate no longer unmounts a screen that is already showing
detail: ScreenVisibilityGate used to fail closed on every error, so one failed live refetch (SSE reconnect, a short 5xx) removed the content and reset unsaved form input. Only the first evaluation fails closed now; after the content was shown, an error keeps it mounted as long as the last good data still matches the condition. The dashboard panel retry path is unchanged.

title: A held multiSelect value that optionsAvailabilityQuery marks unavailable stays listed but cannot be removed
detail: The keep-listed set is taken from the values present when the field mounted, not from the live value. In the checkbox grid the entry is rendered disabled and select-all/deselect-all leave it as is; in the combobox a removal is merged back into the value. Previously unchecking such a role hid it for good while the write path kept it, so the form reported a removal that never happened. A stored lower-case currency code such as usd is normalised to upper case instead of falling back to the field currency, and array values with a non-string element keep their string entries instead of being treated as empty.

title: Screen fallback access, projectionDetail back navigation and stricter prefill
detail: A visibleWhen fallback screen the user may not access now shows the standard unavailable notice instead of a "Screen not found" error. The not-found state of a projectionDetail honours returnTo for its back button. Embedded-list prefill rejects calendar-invalid dates, timestamps with numeric offsets and decimals beyond the safe range, and an empty number param keeps the field default instead of becoming 0.

title: propertyOf type guard and fewer unchecked casts in the UI packages
detail: "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-types/type-guards" exports propertyOf, which reads one property off an unknown value. Headless, renderer, renderer-web and dispatcher-live replace unchecked as-casts and globalThis probes with it and with narrowing. Behavior stays the same for well-formed input; a format spec, upload response or stream event with a wrongly typed property is now ignored instead of passed through.

title: entityList honours allowCreate false
detail: EntityListBody passes no onCreate when the list sets allowCreate false.

title: A declared primaryAction with an icon is icon-only in the phone header
detail: Regardless of confirm or style; the label is the button's aria-label and title. Without an icon it stays a text button. The ui-walkthrough terminate sample uses the circle-stop icon, since a bare x reads as close.

title: Create form prefill and CurrentUserProvider
detail: EntityEditCreateBody applies prefill to empty initial values. New exports CurrentUser, CurrentUserProvider and useOptionalCurrentUser.

title: Read-only view mode for entityEdit
detail: RenderEdit takes viewMode, which disables all fields and removes submit, discard, delete and the dirty footer while keeping record actions and cancel. The update body sets it when screen.readOnly holds for the record and resolves screen:<id>.view.title before screen:<id>.title.

title: EmbeddedListColumn.readOnly and EmbeddedListInput fixedRows
detail: EmbeddedListField forwards both, skips readOnly columns when pasting and never appends rows from a paste when rows are fixed.

title: EmbeddedListColumn.display
detail: EmbeddedListField forwards the select display to the EmbeddedListInput primitive.

title: entityEdit shows locked records as a view
detail: EntityEditUpdateForm shows the view when screen.readOnly matches or entity.lockedWhen matches or its field is missing from the record. Adds the default string errors.recordLocked.

title: Searchable lists show their description as its own row
detail: An entityList or projectionList with search used to hide its description. It now renders as a muted row below the toolbar, the same as on lists without search.
migration: Look at lists that set description together with search. Drop descriptions that were only kept as a hint for developers, or move the text into emptyState if it explains an empty list.

title: FileListField edits images and files fields
detail: RenderField renders type images and files as FileListField instead of the unsupported banner. One tile per stored FileRef id with move up, move down and remove buttons, one trailing empty tile to add a file (hidden at maxCount or when read-only). It is built from Input kind file or image, Button and the layout primitives, passes accept, maxSize, entityType, entityId, fieldName, imageVariant and capture to every tile, and reads only string ids from the stored value. The read-only text display of these fields lists the ids. New i18n keys kumiko.field.file-list.add, move-up, move-down and empty; kumiko.field.file-upload.upload, change, remove, attached and failed; kumiko.field.embedded-list.actions and cell-label. The file and image Input kinds accept entityId. EmbeddedListInput has a new required actionsLabel prop.

title: MultiSelect inputs load optionsAvailabilityQuery and hide unavailable options
HeaderActionGroup replaces the overflow menu child selector for header action wrappers
detail: App wrappers around headerActions are no longer restyled into a stacked column inside the phone overflow menu (the [&>div] child selector reached into app markup). Use HeaderActionGroup instead: a horizontal row in the header, a stacked column in the overflow menu.

title: List card meta values wrap instead of being clipped; more than 3 meta columns fail boot
migration: Narrow list cards (entityList, projectionList, relatedList sections, expandableRow) now render meta values as a dot-separated row that wraps onto further lines instead of being cut off after two lines (and no longer subject to a silent runtime cap of 3 values); only a single value wider than the card is truncated. Meta columns are all columns except the title (first column), the status select and columns with hideOnNarrow: true. validateBoot now rejects a list with more than 3 meta columns and names feature, screen, section and fields. Fix: mark the extra columns hideOnNarrow: true (tables keep them) or drop them. collectCardMetaOverflow(features) from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine lists all offenders at once. headless now also honors hideOnNarrow on reference, derived, row-meta and renderer-only columns, which it previously ignored there.

title: projectionList ignores a URL sort param on columns that are not sortable
detail: A stale link like `?<screen>.sort=<col>` onto a `sortable: false` or unknown column is no longer sent to the server (which answers 400 since 0.355); the screen falls back to its defaultSort.

title: Section actions render in the title row instead of a footer; WriteFormSection submit moves below its fields
migration: Section.actions (renderer-web DefaultSection) render top right in the title row since #3241, no longer as a footer. A button that depends on content below it (a confirmation checkbox, a list it acts on) belongs in the section's children instead of actions. WriteFormSection's own submit button now sits below its fields; caller actions stay in the title row.

title: entityEdit actions can go into the header "..." menu via placement: "menu"
Navigate no longer injects the current id into entityEdit targets of another entity
detail: Navigate actions no longer inject the current record's id into entityEdit targets of another entity; entityList rowActions now recognise same-entity entityEdit targets across features and open them in UPDATE mode

title: translationsByKeyFromLocales export and email-template subpath exports
detail: Renderer exports translationsByKeyFromLocales (inverse of translationsByLocaleFromKeys); bundled-features exposes the auth-email-password and user-data-rights email-templates as subpath exports

title: Grid columns is number | "auto"
detail:
Final review batch F: renderer, renderer-web, types
The boot validator rejects a `listScreenId` that matches no mounted screen, a `sortable` column that the list cannot sort (entityList: any value; projectionList: `true`) and an authored `urlPrefillFields`. `TreeAction` is a union: exactly one of `screen` or `target`. `Button` without children needs `icon` and `ariaLabel`. `RenderEditControls` gains `next` and `back`, and `controls.submit()` saves on an intermediate wizard step. An actionForm money field with a tenant currency that cannot be loaded shows an error instead of submitting with a guessed EUR. The MFA setup and recovery-code buttons sit below the content. The boot context passes Redis to the delivery service, so `notify` with an `idempotencyKey` dedupes. `user:query:user:detail` skips the tenants label when the tenant feature is not mounted.
migration: Pass a number or "auto" to Grid columns; other values no longer type-check.

title: Button without children requires icon and ariaLabel
migration: A custom wrapper that forwards ButtonProps must pass either children or both icon and ariaLabel.

title: RenderEditControls has next and back; submit saves on an intermediate wizard step
migration: No action needed. A host that renders its own wizard buttons with hideActions can call controls.next(), controls.back() and controls.submit().

title: actionForm money fields with a tenant currency block the form when the currency cannot be loaded
migration: No action needed. secretMint and the reference create dialog keep their fallback currency.

title: secretMint with tenant currency waits for the tenant currency in mint and confirm step
detail:
Number inputs no longer keep a typed prefix, secretMint honours tenant currency, refEntity respects real field types
A `NumberInput` draft that does not parse ("12abc", "12,5" on an integer field) now clears the value instead of leaving the last parseable prefix ("12") to be submitted. A `secretMint` screen with `currency: { kind: "tenant" }` money fields now waits for the tenant currency in both the mint and the confirm step, like `actionForm`, instead of seeding a bare `0`. `refEntity` on an `entityList` column or `entityEdit` field no longer overrides a real non-text entity field (a multi-reference stays multi, a sortable column stays sortable). The Tailwind scan skips compiled `__tests__` in `dist`.

title: Select inputs accept disabled options and load their availability from optionsAvailabilityQuery
ModeSwitch gains a pill variant and className, LanguageSwitcher gains a compact chip variant
detail:
ModeSwitch pill variant and LanguageSwitcher chip variant
`ModeSwitch` gets `variant="pill"` (grey track, raised active segment, dark mode aware) and a `className` prop; `outline` stays the default. `LanguageSwitcher` gets `variant="chip"`, a compact monospace chip with the uppercase locale code in a border; `default` stays as it was.

title: TimeseriesChart takes a height, an optional y-axis with gridlines and a date axis with n labels
detail:
TimeseriesChart: height, y-axis gridlines and a date axis
`height` (px) replaces the fixed `h-16`; without it the chart looks as before. `yAxis: { ticks, format? }` draws that many gridlines with rounded value labels (0/200/400/600) in a left gutter, and the y-scale reaches the top tick. `xAxis: { ticks, format }` renders n evenly spaced date labels instead of the fixed start/mid/end of `axisLabels`.

title: useQuery accepts concurrency to cap parallel requests per query name through a pool in the DispatcherProvider
detail:
useQuery option `concurrency` caps parallel requests per query name
`useQuery(type, payload, { concurrency: n })` lets at most n `dispatcher.query` calls of that query name run at once. The pool lives in the DispatcherProvider and is shared by every hook with the same name; the rest wait in line with `loading` still true. A hook that unmounts, refetches or changes its payload while waiting leaves the line without holding a slot, and a finished or failed request hands its slot to the next waiter. Without the option nothing changes.

title: actionForm successMessage names the chosen record's label after a successful submit
detail:
actionForm screens can confirm a submit with the chosen record
A new `successMessage` i18n key on an `actionForm` screen shows a confirmation above the form after a successful submit, for screens that stay put (no `redirect`, not in a drawer). `{field}` placeholders take the submitted values, and a `reference` field shows the chosen record's label instead of its id. The tier-engine admin form uses it: "Tier assigned: Acme → Pro", so choosing the wrong tenant is visible right away. New i18n key: `tier-admin.success` (en/de/es). `RenderEdit`'s `onSubmit` receives the submitted values as a second argument.

title: Switching between generated config screens no longer shows empty fields for stored values
detail:
Settings screens show their stored values after switching screens
Moving from one generated settings screen to another kept the previous screen's form state, so the fields of the new screen rendered empty and a select showed no active option even though a tenant value was set. Each config and secrets screen now mounts its own form.

title: The shell header drops the locked screen's breadcrumb while a visibleWhen fallback or notice is shown
detail:
A locked screen's fallback shows no breadcrumb
When `visibleWhen` is unmet, the route still names the locked screen, so the shell header kept that screen's breadcrumb above the fallback or the unavailable notice. The gate now mounts `<PageHeader hideBreadcrumb />`, and the shell header drops the breadcrumb while it is mounted. Embedded screens (dashboard panels, drawers) are not affected.

title: Screens take visibleWhen and fallback
detail: Any screen can gate itself on a query field with `visibleWhen`, including on direct URL access. Unmet or failed conditions render the `fallback` screen or a standard notice instead of the content. New i18n key: `kumiko.screen.unavailable`.

title: Banner gets title, titleTestId and variant "primary"
detail:
Banner takes title, titleTestId and variant "primary"
`BannerProps` gets `title` (bold heading above the text), `titleTestId` and the variant `"primary"` for call-to-action notices: left accent in the primary color, neutral background, `actions` right of the text on wide screens and below it on narrow ones. Existing variants render unchanged.

title: Add errors.rate_limit_unavailable default text
Lightbox pages through multiple images
detail: `LightboxProps` is now a union: the existing `src`/`alt` form is unchanged, and the new `images` + `index` + `onIndexChange` form renders previous/next buttons, a position counter and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigation with wrap-around when more than one image is given. The Apex lightbox collects every `.shot-frame img` on open and gains previous/next buttons; its CSP script hash changed. New i18n keys: `kumiko.lightbox.previous`, `kumiko.lightbox.next`, `kumiko.lightbox.position`.

title: configEdit number and money fields start empty without a default
detail: Number and money fields without a default no longer show 0, so saving does not write an unintended 0. Clearing a stored value resets this scope's override instead of sending an empty number.

title: Secrets screen hides keys the user cannot write
detail: The generated secrets screen now hides fixed secret keys the current user may not write according to the key's `writeRoles`, and drops sections left without visible keys. The generator emits a per-field `fieldAccess` map on the screen for this. It only affects what the UI shows; the server-side write check is unchanged and still decides.

title: configEdit shows server validation errors at the affected field
detail: `config:write:set` reports its issues at path `value`. The configEdit submit maps the issues of the failed batch command (`failedIndex`) to that command's field, and RenderEdit puts server field issues from a `customSubmit` into the form controller, the same way `controller.submit()` does. The banner stays for issues no rendered field can show and for network failures.
migration: No code change needed.

title: DataTableRowGrouping.headerLabel may return undefined
detail: `DataTableRowGrouping.headerLabel` returns `string | undefined`. `undefined` means the group has no header: the default web DataTable renders its rows without a header row and never collapses them.
migration: Custom DataTable primitives that render `rowGrouping` handle `undefined` from `headerLabel` by rendering the group's rows without a header.

title: Tabs fallback, error-tab jump, list search echo and money currency no longer misbehave
detail: A tabs layout on a host with `Tabs` but no `WizardStepGroup` now falls back to a stacked form instead of throwing. After a server validation error the form jumps to the first tab that actually shows the errored field, skipping tabs where it is hidden. A delete handler that returns a non-error value no longer shows an empty error banner. The list search box keeps keystrokes typed while the parent echoes the previous search value late. A money value whose stored currency is not a three-letter code falls back to the field currency instead of crashing the screen. Embedded-list reference columns remount instead of breaking hook order when the column set changes. The wizard step check parses the form once per change instead of once per step.

title: Header subtitle without MetricBand and navigateToReturn state no longer misbehave
detail: A projectionDetail header subtitle stays visible on a host with `PageHeader` but no `MetricBand`. `navigateToReturn` applies the restored host state only when the return target is the host the `returnTo` value names, so a caller-supplied target no longer inherits a foreign host's tab, filters and nested `returnTo`. The `screenPadding` and `scrollBody` docs now state that `scrollBody` wins, and the number input docs match the web behavior.

title: Screen actions and URL prefill no longer leave stale, doubled or invalid state
detail: An entityEdit delete action with a `redirect` now still reports the deletion to its host, and a delete with no entity list screen reloads the record instead of leaving the form on the deleted record. Overflow-menu actions are disabled while one is running, so a second click can no longer fire the write twice. URL prefill ignores an empty money param, non-finite number params, embedded-list cells with too many decimals or invalid dates, and a dateRange filter with `from` after `to` is put in order before it reaches the handler.

title: LiveEvent data has no payload, it carries eventType
detail: `LiveEvent.data` is now `{ id, aggregateType, eventType, version, createdAt }`. The server sends signals only, so consumers refetch through a query.
migration: Replace reads of `event.data.payload` with a query refetch. `useQuery({ live: true })` already does this and needs no change.

title: useReportStepComplete reports an extension wizard step's completeness without a raw useEffect
detail: `useReportStepComplete(props.reportStepComplete, complete)` with `complete: boolean | null`. `null` reports nothing (data loading), a boolean is reported whenever it changes. Outside update-mode wizards `reportStepComplete` is undefined and the hook does nothing.
migration: Extension steps that call `reportStepComplete` from a `useEffect` should switch to `useReportStepComplete(reportStepComplete, complete)`; app repos need this to pass the no-raw-hooks guard.

title: secretMint reveal and confirm render as one screen form with the translated screen title; new RenderEdit props leadContent and i18nScreenId
Router paths encode and decode each segment, so entity ids with slashes or spaces round-trip
Icon-only list and edit action buttons set a hover title
Secret delete confirmation, grouped-field conditions, scoped valid flag, tenant currency in reference-create dialog
detail: Renderer review fixes. Deleting a secret on a secretsEdit screen now asks for confirmation first (new `config.secrets.deleteConfirm` key) and the delete button is disabled while a save or delete is running. The multiSelect checkbox group is exposed as a labelled group (`GridProps.ariaLabelledBy`). The inline reference-create dialog seeds `currency: { kind: "tenant" }` money fields from the tenant currency. Fields declared only inside a section `groups` entry now get their `visible`/`readOnly`/`required` conditions registered. `onChange`'s `valid` ignores issues on hidden fields and outside the `fields` scope, like submit does (shared `relevantFieldIssues` helper). Copy-link in the form footer keeps a 44px touch target on narrow viewports. A free-text sibling-field number unit longer than 8 characters is no longer rendered as a suffix.

title: Scoped validation matches exact paths, root refine issues are visible, tabs keep the active tab by id, update redirects use the saved FK, related list sorting handles numeric strings, nulls and locales
detail: Form and list fixes. A scoped `validate()` entry such as `address.city` no longer reports sibling issues like `address.zip`. Root-level `.refine()` issues now show as a banner in `RenderEdit` instead of blocking submit silently. In tabs mode the active tab follows its id when a field change hides an earlier tab, and an explicit subtitle override is kept. An entityEdit update redirect with `idFrom` reads the saved projection, so a changed parent FK redirects to the new parent. A row-extractor key missing from the row no longer wipes the target field's default. `relatedList` client-side sorting orders numeric strings by value, puts empty values last and compares text locale-aware. A reference list facet warns in dev when the lookup hits its row cap.

title: writeForm section shows the error banner for issues no rendered field can display
detail: A writeForm section keeps its error banner when the server reports an issue no rendered field can show (`version`, `id`, a root-level refine, a hidden field), instead of failing the save without any visible message.

title: Wizard editing an existing record shows data-based done state and allows jumping to any step; delete record actions leave the screen
detail: Update-mode wizards compute done per step from the record (valid, non-empty fields, or passed via Next) and make every non-current step a jump target; forward jumps run the current step's validate gate. `ExtensionSectionProps.reportStepComplete` lets extension steps report completeness. `StepBar` gets `doneSteps` and `selectableSteps`. A writeHandler record action with `redirect`, or a delete of the shown record, navigates away (returnTo, redirect, listScreenId, entity list) instead of refetching.
migration: Extension wizard steps in an entityEdit that edits an existing record should call `reportStepComplete(true)` (usually from an effect) once they hold their data, otherwise the step bar shows them as not done until the user passes them with Next. This also applies to singleton wizards (e.g. a company-setup wizard), whose steps now show done by data and are all jump targets; tests that assumed back-only chips must be updated. A delete writeHandler action on a projectionDetail or entityEdit now navigates away after success (returnTo, else listScreenId or the entity's list) instead of refetching into "record not found"; set `redirect` to choose another target. List row actions are unchanged.

title: New optional screen options for facet chips, default filters, row action display, drawer titles, footer actions, grouped related lists and wizard side info
detail:
entityList: `facets` (per-field `display: "chips"`, `showCounts`, `hideEmpty`, `extraOptions`, or `false` to hide), `defaultFilters` (initial value only, the URL wins, "no filter" stays chosen) and `rowActionMode`. Row actions get `display: "button" | "link" | "icon"`; with `display` set an action stays inline next to the kebab. Drawer actions get `title` / `subtitle` (i18n keys, `{param}` filled from the row prefill). Edit fields get `submit: false` (kept out of the payload), actionForm gets `footerActions` (patch values, then submit), relatedList gets `groupBy` / `rowTone` / `rowActionMode`. Wizard sections get `subtitle`, `layout.wizard.aside.upNext` adds an "up next" box, entityEdit gets `titleTemplate`. `Button` gets a `pressed` style, the DataTable contract `rowGrouping` / `rowTone`, `StepBar` `subtitles` / `upNext`, `Drawer` `subtitle`.
- Screenshot runner: `SCREENSHOT_DESKTOP_WIDTH` overrides the desktop viewport width (default 1920).
migration: No code change needed.

title: projectionDetail header subtitle can show several parts, each optionally linking to the referenced record
detail: `header.subtitle` accepts a list of parts (field name or `{ field, navigate }`). Empty parts drop out, the rest are joined by a "·" separator, and a part with `navigate` links to the referenced record (entity or screen target, only when reachable). The Link primitive gets an optional `onPress` for SPA navigation, Text an optional `decorative` flag. `subtitleHref` stays valid with the string form only; the boot validator rejects the combination with a list.
migration: No code change needed.

title: entityList rows can expand into a related list with its own row actions (expandableRow)
detail: `expandableRow` on an entityList declares a related list under each row, with the same fields as a projectionDetail `relatedList` section (query, `parentFilter` or `parentParam`, columns, row and toolbar actions, emptyState). The parent id is the row's `id`. An arrow button at the start of the row opens and closes the area, carries `aria-expanded`, and works by keyboard. Several rows can be open at once. A successful write from the area reloads both the related list and the parent list, so counters on the parent row update. The boot validator and the role projection check the area like a relatedList section. `DataTableProps` gains `expandedRowIds`, `onToggleRowExpanded` and `renderExpandedRow` for custom DataTable primitives.

title: relatedList columns format select, date and other field types like entityList columns (entity)
detail: A relatedList section (projectionDetail tab or entityList `expandableRow`) takes an optional `entity`: an entity name or `feature:entity`. Columns that name a field of that entity render through the same cell formatter as an entityList column. A select shows as a status badge with its translated option label, dates are locale-formatted, and the header defaults to the field's label key. A column's own `sortable` still controls the header sort. The boot validator rejects an `entity` that does not resolve. Without `entity`, columns render as before.

title: Boolean fields in flow forms use FieldCellWidth "toggle" instead of "auto"
detail: In flow forms (screen forms and drawers) a boolean field's label now shares the top line with its neighbours' labels and the switch sits on the input line. The `FieldCellWidth` union loses `"auto"` and gains `"toggle"`; the default web Grid maps it to a fixed minimum width.
migration: Custom Grid/GridCell primitives keyed by FieldCellWidth: rename `auto` to `toggle`.

title: projectionDetail tab panels get page padding, recordTitleField on projectionDetail
detail: Tab panels on a projectionDetail with `layout.mode: "tabs"` now pad their content like the rest of the page: extension, field-section, groups and writeForm tabs render as an unframed padded panel with space below the tab strip. relatedList tabs stay flush. This fixes extension tabs sitting flush against the shell edge since 0.330.0. `CardOptions.framed` (default true) drops the card frame and keeps the padding. A projectionDetail without `header` can set `recordTitleField`: the query output field then titles the page header (breadcrumb "list > record"). The boot check requires the field to be in the query's outputSchema and rejects it next to `header`.
migration: Extension tab panels get their padding back, so extension components that added their own padding to make up for the flush panel in 0.330.0 should drop it. Set `recordTitleField: "<field>"` on a projectionDetail without `header` to show the record name in the breadcrumb.

title: entityEdit screens show the server's reason when a delete is rejected
detail: The reason (for example from a preDelete hook) now appears in the form-error banner instead of the confirm dialog closing silently. `RenderEdit`'s `onDelete` may return the rejected write's `DispatcherError` for this.

title: Screen schema gains createScreen, recordTitleField and configEdit fillHeight; extension tabs render unframed
detail: `createScreen` on an entityList names the screen opened by the create button. `recordTitleField` on an entityEdit shows a field value as the record title in the header breadcrumb (list > record > screen title). `fillHeight` on a configEdit (default true) switches it to the screen-form layout with a pinned footer; `false` restores the card layout. All three are optional and validated at boot. Extension tabs on a projectionDetail no longer wrap their content in a Card, like relatedList tabs. A `headerSlot` now renders inside the page-header slot instead of replacing the header.
migration: Additive. Set `createScreen: "<screen-id>"` on an entityList and `recordTitleField: "<field>"` on an entityEdit to use them. configEdit screens now fill the shell height; set `fillHeight: false` to keep the card layout. Apps with screenshot tests of extension tabs lose the surrounding card frame.

title: Screens fill the shell height by default
detail: entityList, projectionList, projectionDetail, entityEdit, actionForm and wizard screens now fill the height of the shell content. The table or the form body scrolls inside, the toolbar stays on top and the pager or action bar stays pinned at the bottom (`scrollBody`, `stickyActions`). The shell header is 56px. Custom screens and direct DataTable or Form usage are unchanged.
migration: Set `fillHeight: false` on a screen to restore the old page scrolling (table grows with its rows, pager below the last row, form footer in the flow). Apps with e2e or screenshot tests that scroll the page to reach the pager or the form footer need to adjust them or opt out per screen.

title: Pager shows a status line, page size select and Page X of Y instead of page numbers
detail: The numbered page list is gone. The list footer shows "1-19 of 19 <entities>" (with the entity plural label when known), "Page X of Y", previous and next buttons and a page size select (25, 50, 100). Lists without a pager show a plain entry count. The chosen size is kept in the URL under `<screen>.size`.
migration: Remove code and tests that click numbered page buttons (`-page-N` test ids); use the next and previous buttons. The screen's declared `pageSize` stays the default, `<screen>.size` in the URL overrides it. The new keys `kumiko.pager.pageOf`, `kumiko.pager.status.noun`, `kumiko.pager.pageSize`, `kumiko.pager.pageSizeLabel`, `kumiko.list.count.*` exist in en, de and es; apps with their own locale need them too.

title: rowActionMode adaptive has new semantics and mobile rows lose the kebab for plain navigation
detail: With `rowActionMode: "adaptive"` (the default), a table with `onRowClick` renders the first cell as a keyboard-operable link and puts all row actions into the kebab. Without `onRowClick` the primary row action is a link-button and the remaining actions go into the kebab (a single action gets no kebab). Below the md breakpoint a row that only navigates shows a chevron and no kebab.
migration: Code or tests that expect up to two inline row action buttons must open the kebab or use `rowActionMode: "inline"`, which is unchanged. To keep a visible action next to the row link, drop `onRowClick` and declare the action as the primary row action.

title: Form, wizard and detail screens use the board layout
detail: Screen forms have no card, sections are separated by lines, fields flow in rows with widths by type (text 240px, number 96px, money 160px, date and select 200px, textarea full row) and the page title lives in the shell header. Delete and Copy link move into the header kebab, the footer reads status, Cancel, Save, and the wizard footer has no Cancel. Wizard steps sit in a vertical rail from the lg breakpoint. The first detail header action is a button, further ones sit in the kebab. Detail screens have no header card and use the full width: metrics render as a dl band, tabs are underlined only when active, related lists are full-bleed with a count footer. Required-field asterisks are omitted when every field is required and "All fields are required." is shown instead.
migration: Adjust screenshots and DOM tests that pin the old card layout. `fillHeight: false` restores page scrolling only; the footer order, the moved actions and the new field layout apply in both modes. Empty list cells render a dash.

title: PageHeader slot, MetricBand, wizard Save and close, drawer row actions with unsaved-input guard
detail: Core primitives `PageHeader` (status and actions portalled into the shell header when a shell provides the slot, otherwise the caller keeps its placement) and `MetricBand` (borderless dl of metrics) are new and optional. Wizards on an existing record show "Save and close". Row actions and related list row actions with `kind: "drawer"` open the action form in a flush drawer. Closing it with unsaved input (X, Escape, overlay, Cancel) asks for confirmation first; nothing is asked after a successful submit. Row action drawers are prefilled from the row through `params`. The action form `summary` renders a context box above the fields.

title: Related list no longer claims "showing the first N entries" for a complete list
detail: The hint "Zeigt die ersten 1 Einträge. Es gibt weitere, die hier nicht angezeigt werden." appeared for a single row even when nothing else existed. It now appears only when more rows exist than were loaded.

title: writeForm section Save button without icon, parity with entityEdit
detail: The Save button of a writeForm section no longer shows a check icon; it matches the entityEdit submit button. Tests that look for the icon inside the section Save button need updating.

title: useQuery gains a refetchIntervalMs option for polling
detail: With `refetchIntervalMs` set, an enabled query re-runs on a timer. Background ticks keep `loading` false, are skipped while a fetch is still in flight, and stop on unmount or when enabled, the interval, type or payload change. Only timers are used, so it works on web and React Native.

title: Server validation issues without a rendered field keep the error banner
detail:
RenderEdit suppressed the banner as soon as the server returned any field issue, even one
that no rendered field can display (`version`, `id`, a root-level refine, a condition-hidden
field), so the save failed silently. The banner now stays whenever at least one issue has no
visible field; tabs/wizard layouts still jump to the step holding the first matched field.

title: Server validation errors on entityEdit update forms reach their fields again
detail:
The update form sends `{ id, version, changes }`, so server validation issues arrive as
`changes.<field>`. The form controller stored them under that key, so no field showed the
error, tabs/wizard layouts never jumped to the erroring tab (only the generic banner), and
single-section forms failed silently. A new submit option `serverFieldPathPrefix` strips the
nesting key; KumikoScreen's update form sets it to `changes.`. Paths without the prefix are unchanged.

title: navigateWithReturnTo carries returnTo for entity ObjectTargets
detail:
navigateWithReturnTo now accepts a NavTarget (ScreenTarget or ObjectTarget),
not just ScreenTarget. For an entity target it compares the resolved href
against the host's to detect a self-navigate (no returnTo) and otherwise
sets returnTo to the host snapshot, same as the existing screen-target
path. runProjectionRowNavigate, buildNavigateRecordAction, EntityListBody's
row navigate and related-list-section's legacy rowClick now go through
this for entity actions.

title: Toolbar navigate actions merge `tab` into the search params
detail:
buildNavigateToolbarAction (shared by entityList, projectionList and
relatedList-section toolbars) sets `tab` in the same params object as any
declared `params`/prefill, so it lands in the single navigateWithReturnTo
call next to returnTo.

title: App theme as one Tailwind plugin instead of duplicated @theme and :root blocks
detail: An app declares its colors (a string, or `{ light, dark }`), base radius, fonts, card shadow and card padding once in `defineAppTheme({...})`, default-exports `createThemePlugin(theme)` from e.g. `src/theme.ts`, and adds `@plugin "./theme.ts";` after the renderer-web import in its styles.css. The plugin writes into the same base layer after the framework palette, so the app values win in light and dark mode without repeating them in `:root`/`.dark`; colors the framework does not know get utilities (`bg-brand-soft`). `fonts.sans` also sets the body font. The framework's `--card-padding/--card-radius/--card-shadow` defaults moved into `@layer base` (an app's unlayered `:root` still overrides them, an app `@theme` value still does not).
